tei:div.tei:p: yas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig leldi: zab tig yang snying 'dus pa las bla sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs so: yas / na mo gu ru pa rlu ka ra ye dzanasha rgyasgro mchog tu mi 'gyur dad mos brtan khyed shes dad pas gsol gdab ni e ma hoḥ chos sku mi g.yo thig le nyag gcig ngang longs spyod rdzogs pa kha spyor yan lag bdunaḥ sprul pa'i sku mchog rigs gsum sems dpa' laḥ gsol 'debs dgongs rgyud klong chen rtogs pa spor 'bras bu'i chos mdzod dga' rab rdo rje dang don dam gnad bkrol shrī seng ha'i zhabasaḥ bi ma mi drwa ye shes bka' rgya mtshor gsol 'debs dgongs rgyud klong chen rtogs pa sboraX bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sgrub sde'i grub brtes rig 'dzin chen po brgyad 'gro 'dul gu ru 'phrul mtshan nyi shu lngaraḥ gsol 'debs dgongs rgyad klong chen rtogs pa sporaX mtshan mchog brgyad dang grub dbang brgyad cu dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter chen brgya rtsa sogs rtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams laḥ

gsol 'debs dgogs rgyud bdechen gar bsgyur dpa' bo yab yum brgyad 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje mtsho rgyal maḥ gnas yul ḍāk+ki bka' nyan pho nya laX gsola'adebs don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod ma dag sgyu ma'i mtshan 'dzin rang sar dgaḥ sku dang ye shes chen po'i rol par rdzogasaḥ ma rig gzhir sangs chos nyid 'khor61ra smin dpal mchog gdod ma'i mgon por byang chub 31ga0 de ltar gsol btab don gnyis 'grub phyi nang bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal ཿ nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas bsam pa lhun rgyas grub pa ra'agyur sa ma yuḥ brag dkar seng ge' mgul bum las sred len ma mchis brda mdzod ni lha sman ḍak+ki'i glu yis bskul ngan lam rgyal mtshago sprul pa yas lcags 'brug lo la brda ris las snyesgome ches kyirdo rje 'amaḥnam mkha'i dbang phyug bya ba yis rten 'brel dus tshig dang po ma chos kyi bdag po thub bstan dbang rten 'brel phun tshogs mas bcas ro ra dag par phab pa maṅga le/

yas 1 dkar gtor khrul ba ni treḥ rin chen snod du oṃ yig las gter ma bdud rtsi'i phung por gyur ma.āḥ(ཿ lan gsum kyiḥ ye shesamagon po bka' 'khor bcasaḥ dbyings kyi ma drug sprul g.yog dpungaX drang sgong skyes chen gi gi tshogasaX gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngaX 'dir gnas zo dor dregs can rnams mchod gtor skyems bzhes phrin las sgrubasaḥ ko long gdug rtsub mi mnga' bar zhi zhing byams pa'i gnas mgron gyis dam tshig srung la bde legs rtsolaḥ las kyi 'bras bu gang yin pa sgogs med sgrubs shig sa ma māḥ ces brjod la dkar skyems mchod/phrin las gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur roḥs ma wā slob bu thub bstan dbang po bskul ngor ste sgom chosakyi rdo rjesabrasapa masgo le/yas 1 kun la sbyar ba' tshogs bsags ni na mo rig pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid laḥ ngo mtshar lta bas phyag 'tshal lo0 ro mnyam kun bzang mchod pa 'bulaḥ gnyis snang dri ma dbu mar bshagasaX dus gsum mnyam klong rjes yi rangaX ka dag zang thal chos 'khor bskul mi g.yo rdo rje ltar bzhugs gsol0 'gro kun rang rig rtogs phyir

bsngoḥsku gsum mnyam rdzogs thob par shog cesakyang snyeb bam dbang phyug ngoraḥsnyebs nam mkha'idabang phyug gis dag par phab pa masgo le/sgrub pa'i rgyal ma3 'dzug gyur cigaḥsarba maṅga le dza yan+tu

yas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyi: zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ bla sgrub yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥyaX 1 — na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye sha rte spyo /tsho dngosagrub kun gyi 'byung gnas che bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo chos ldan bskal ba bzang po can nye lam gu ru sgrub la 'bongaḥ sa ma shāḥ bla rdo dri med shel rdo rje'i logs brgyad zur ma nyams pa da nga sku 'bags bhasto me long dzos sgrub gtor nyer spyod yo byad bkrams mos gus dad brtson ti 'dzan bzhi sgrub rten bla na med pa'oḥ sa ma māḥ dang po skyabasasu 'gro ba ni na mo rigs kun yongasa'adusabla ma niX ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i gteraḥ lhan skyes ye shes spros mtha' bralaḥ ngo bo rig pas skyabs su mchi gnyisapa semasabaskyed ram pa ni hoḥ 'khor 'das gnyam nyid ye shes dbyingasaḥ brdal khyab rig pa byang chub semasaḥ yod min med min mtha' las 'dasaḥ ma skye ye yin kun khyab bsgomaḥgasum pa dgegs tshogs bsgrad pa ni hrīḥ rnam kun chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la ༷ bgegs dang log 'dren ming yang medaX 'on kyang gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin bdud rang grol dbu ma

chen por bskradaḥ bzhi pa bsrung 'khor sgom pa niḥtrīḥphyogs mtha' dbus su mi dmigs paX kun zlum thig le chen po ni gzhom gzhig med pa rdo rje'i gur srung dang srung bya ye sangs rgyas lnga pa byin chen 'bebasapa niḥ hrī mi gnas dag pa chos sku'i klong rang bzhin 'od gsal thig le 'khyelaḥ brda don rtags rdzogs sprul pa skuḥ brgyud gsum bla ma'i byin phob cigaX drug pa mar rdzas byin pos niḥ hrīḥ yul drug dag pa'i gsal sgo rtsa 'dod yon rgyan bkod phun tshogs gteraḥ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bral ba rtsa ngo mtshar kun bzang sprin du spelaḥ de ni sbyor ba sngon 'gro'oḥs ma yuḥdang po ting 'dzan rnams gsum niḥ.ā smra bsam brjod bral de bzhin nyidaX kun khyab ye shes kun tu snang: 'gag med rgyu yi sa bon hrī stong chen btsun mo'i mkha' las shar gnyis pa pho brang dal bskyed naḥ hrīḥ brtan gapo'i mtshan ma chos skur sangasaḥ 'byung chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong duX rang byung 'od gsal gzhal yas khangaḥ sgo gru rta babs rgyan bkod bcasaḥ brda don rtags rdzogs dri ma medaX ngo mtshar 'od dkyil zang thal dbus ma chags pad sdong gyes pa'i khar thabs shes nyi zla zung

yas 1 'jug stengaX rang rig bla ma pad+ma 'byung snang srid zil gnon cha byad can ཿ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsdigs g.yon pas bhan+ta dku la brten phod mthing zaber chos gos dngaX mthing sham gsang gos 'dung ma dang rin chen mgul rgyan dar spyangs mdzes zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol thabs bzhugs pad zhwa sgro dar me long dang nyi zla nor bu rin chen phra rtse rgyal gser gyi rdo rje mdzes mchan g.yon lha lcam sbas pa'i tshulaḥ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum rtags su 'chang 0 blta stangs sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug thugs rje'i 'od chen bu la 'gyedaX spyo bor 'od lnga zlum 'khrul 1ngaḥ kun bzang yab yum nam mkha'i mdog sgrub sder mnga' brnyes rig 'dzin brgyadaḥ phyogs bzhi dkar ser dmar dang ljangaX mtshams rnams mazing ga 'od lus cheḥ kun kyang he ru ka pa'i chasaḥ rus rgyan dar dpyangs e rag mdzes cang te'u dril bu bhan+ta 'dzinaḥ sna tshogs gar bsgyur dngas ma'i skuḥ gsal la 'dzin med chen por sgom phyi rim dpa' bo yab yum brgyad bde stong phyag rgya'i gar la spyodaX dar dang rat+na'i rgyan cha 'chang gri gug bhan+ta bsnol thabs

'dzinaX sgo bzhir ging chen sde bzhi niḥ rus pa'i gzugs can ha ha rgodaḥ gsang ba'i rnge'u chung tir tir sgrogasaḥ brda bsgyur bro gar sna tshogs stonaḥ mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam can rnamasaḥ nyi bzhin gsal la rlung ltar 'tshubs kun kyang gnas gsum sa bon dang thugasaka'i srog lasa'od 'phros pas rnga yab gling dang 'og min gnasaX rang bzhin dag pa'i pho brang nas rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus paḥ gu ru pad+ma'i rnam pa nas gnyis med du ma ro gcig gyur gsum pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni trī rang bzhin 'od gsal sprul sku'i zhingaḥrnga yab pad+ma 'od gling nas mnyam nyid thugs rje bla ma'i sku gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin rlabs stsolaX bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba niḥtrī: sgyu 'phrul sprul b.lidakyil 'khor nas gshegs byon mi dmigs bla ma'i skuḥ 'khru 'khor chos skur sangs ba'i phyir bde chen mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs lnga pa phyag 'tshal rim pa ni na ma rang byung ye shes byang chub sems don dam bla ma'i gsang ba gsumaḥ mtha' bral mi shig rdo rje cheḥ rang ngo rig pa'i phyag 'tshal loḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba niḥhrīḥ bzung 'ardon mtshan ma chos smrar sangasaḥ

yas 1 dag chen phyi nang gsang mchod sprinaḥ yid 'ong lha mos spros bsdu bcas rig 'dzin bla ma'i dal du 'bul thugs rjes brtse dgongs dgyes par bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'khrul ba gzhir sangs nyams rtogs sporaX tshe 'dir rigs 'dzin sa la skyolaḥ bdun pa bstod pa'i glu mchod niḥ hū hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuX bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje pad sdong las byon bla ma sprul pa'i sku sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstodaḥ dur khrod brgyad bshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad sgrub sde brgyad kyi gsang mdzod klong nas bkrolaX bde byed brtsegs par zab rgya'i dngos grub brnyesaḥ rig 'dzin chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ gzhan yang rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du0 dam tshig thugs rjes 'khod pa'i mkha' 'gro dngaḥ dam can dpa' bo dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod 'pho med phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol brgyad pa 'dzab dgongs niḥtrīḥ rang rig bla ma pad 'byung giḥ thugs dkar gser gyi rdo rje yi lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs rig pa yi ge hrīḥ dmar ser sngags phreng gser

thag lta bus bskor bzlas pas snang srid dbang thob cingaḥ bde dang stong pa'i 'od gsal 'bar gnyis snang sems kyi dri kun dgaḥ gang shar bde klong rol pa che mnyam nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngangaX tshogatsitāḥs badz+ras/ nag pad+ma sirnyi hūṃX gang shar rang grol don la gnas mi gnas bde chen ye shesazhal bskur thabs bral ba'i spyi blugs su mngon sum gcer byung lhag ger mthong lam nyams rtogs stobs rgyas te don kun grub par the tshom med sa ma māḥ dgu pa sgrub pa'ibazlas dmags ni trīḥ rang rig bla ma pad+ma 'byung: thugs rje'i sprul sku bla na medaḥ ye shes zang thal 'dzab kyi rgyun gang shar rang grol ngang brkyangs nas sgod bcud brtan g.yo'i khams rnams kunaḥ dkyil 'khor gsum du rdzogs sangs rgyas ma༅ hūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ya dza sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ 'dzab rgyun chu bo'i gzhung bzhan bzla dgongs pa de bzhan nyid la gnas rang grol rol ba'i nyams len gyis rtogs pa'i gzi byin 'bar zhing rgyasaḥ sam māḥ bsapa la sbyor 'dzab dmigs ni hriḥ thabs kyi dbye ba thod phreng rtsal shes rab rang bzhin phag mo yumaḥ thugs rje'i rang rtsal mkha' 'gro ging mnyam nyid bde chen dgongs pa'i 'dzab 'od

yas / gsal phrin las khyab brdal bsaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa lhun grub gyis grubaḥ ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po'i ngangaX hrī mnya ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya tsit+ta hrīng hrīng dzadza bzlas sngags ti 'dzan gzer gyis gdab 'phro 'du phrin las thogs med 'byung sa lam nyams rtogs rtsal chen rdzo gas don gnyis yid bzhin 'byu bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥde ni darngosagaje'i rim pa'oḥ rgya rgya rgya de nasadangos grub zhu bskul ni kye hoḥ byams mgon thugs rje che ba'i bdag nyid can0 rdo rje rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas dgongs0 bsnyen cing sgrub pa las sbyor mtha' ru phyinaḥ dngos grub stsol len dus la da bab pasaX mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub rgya mtsho stsolaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma māX rtsa sngags mthar kā ya sirnyi maX wāk+ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sidhi hūṃX sarba sirnyi trīX brgya stong la sogs brjod pa ra bya stong tshig gis ni mchod bstod byed tho rang las gzhung bsrang bar bya bro bshags sman mchod nyuste bsgrad byin dbab grub rjes 'jab bskul ni nam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba rnams rjes chags kyi sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun nar gyis babaḥ bdag bskyed kyi

gnas bzhir 'od zer sna lnga'i rgyun gyi bar ma chad pa'i tshul du thim sgrub bya dang sgrub byed dbyer med du gyur bar bsam la hūṃ hrīḥ bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i sku'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsolaX brnya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa dam chos yongs 'dus gsung gsang gi byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ dharma pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: chos nyid spros rtog mi mnga' ba'i ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsolaX rat+na tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃḥ khyab bdag bdechen rdo rje yi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyiḥ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub rgyun da lta nyid la stsal du gsol thogs med stobs dang 'phur ldan gshogaX 'chi med tshe dang zas nor srid mnga' thang 'byor ba'i dngos grub rgyun da lta nyid la stsal du gsolaḥ sarba garma a snyi ྅don hrīX 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dngos grub blangs shisapa brjod la me tog 'thor bar chad g.yul las rnam par rgyalaḥdon gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyuraḥ sam māḥde rjesakyi rim pa'o rgya rgya rgyaḥdagongasabargyud minus thig le che bdo brgyud dpal gyi bum pa bzang snyan brgyud dri med shesaphreng gi gdams pa 'od gsal klong yangs skor chos sde zab tig yang snying 'dus zab rgya

rim/ / shes rdzong nor bu' phra gtad rgya rgyal mchog dbyangasal son dus sad sa mo yos kyi lor sred len bral ba'i brda risalas dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje'i rgyud bcu phrag gsum gyi rgya rted pa ngan lamazhabs 'bri bkur sti mkhan pad+ma dus kyi snying po yi skye phreng rdo rje rigs kyi tshul gzhen nu thub bstan bkra shis la bka' rgya bkrol ba ma lamaḥsarba dza yan+tu

ra/ 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyi:zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ'o yug gtsang btsan yab yum gyi mchod phreng phrin las lhun grub bzhugs soḥgs 1 na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye 113)zabarten rgyal ba kun dngos pad+mā 'byung ཿmthon mthing ral bas gtugs te btudaḥskal bzang sgrub mchog pho mo yis dam chos byang chub lhur len skabs nyer 'tshe bdud bgegs sri gzhes phyir srung ma dam sgog ga gta' ru gcesaḥs ma yuḥbarten thabs bla rdo srog 'khor gces sgrub thabs dam tshig gnad bcing gzab bskang tshe mchod dzos yo byad bsags mchod na mnyes pa'idam sa sbungs de gnad theb byang spug rgyud dang zhi sgrub drag sgrub dug sgrub rnams skal dman lag tu 'chor mi rung dam rgya gnad drug ldan pa sa 'chongasaḥs ma yuḥzen chen snyed du gtor ma ni 'khar thabs bang rim gsum pal nor bu mag gsum tog gas mdzes ra yi rgyal mtshan ra mgo'i phra yum bshos shel kong lta bu mdun rnam lnga nyer spyod yo byad bkrams dar tshon mda' 'phang nam mkha' dang bal brgyang sa rtags rgyal srid bdun ngomatshar yid du 'ong bar bya rang nyid rtsa gsum gang rung gi bskyed rim ting 'dzin brtan po yis kyaḥrang mdun dri bral gangs ri 'ja' 'byug pa'iḥganyis 'thung cang shes yangs pa'i rtse 'jo bsgyur

dbyar rnga gser mig gnam ri dkar po 'phyoḥ gdong lnga 'dab chags skyin gyi 'dod pa 'joḥ zangs mkhar 'od 'bar rtse la nyi zlas mdzesaX sgo khyud bang rim 'dod snam nor sna'i phyuraX bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun dang lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor sprin 'khrigs dbus seng chen g.yu ral spud steng skyes mchog rtsalaḥ 'o yug gtsang btsan dmar smug mdangs ldan skuX sbyan bsgrad khro la cung zad 'dzum nyams rgyasaḥ dar sngon 'dung ma gser gyi ske rag bcingaX rin chen g.yu yi phreng ba sum rim 'phyangasaX be+eḍūr chu shel sngon po'i gdu bu mdzesaX dar dkar la ber dmar ser dpyangs pa sprasaḥ dbu la bse zhu rdo rje nor bu'i togaḥ 'od 'bar me dud rlung gi zer dngar 'phroḥrdo rje dang ni dgra snying dmar rlon bsnams shadas la sag ri'i lhum mjesaphyed 'bying rolaḥ g.yon ngos gangs dkar lha mo she ne sman dar dmar mdangs ldan dar chas rin chen brgyan zhi 'dzum nyams rgyas lcags kyu gter bum bsnams skyin dmar me yi 'dab ma can la bcibs de 'khor bod skyongs bstan ma sman gyi tshogs bya seng ra skyes zhon pa'i mched

la / 'khor g.yogaX sum brgya drug cu gza' skar bkra bzhin 'khyugaḥ bstan la gdung zhing sgrub la brtse shugs ldan: kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa rin chen dngaḥ der 'dzin bu la snying nye brtse gdung canaḥ sgog gi yi ge las bskul rang bzhin gyiḥ gnas nas spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims snyan gsan dbab pa niḥho dgongs su gsol loX skyes bu ging drug gi gnyer 'dzin gtsang btsan drag sngags shul gyi bdag po mdo sngags ris med kyi bka' sdod khyad par rdzogs chen gyi gnyer 'dzin rin chen gter kha yi srung maX mched 'khor sum brgya dang drug cuḥ dgyes bskyed gangs dkar lha she neX sman phran sprul ba dang bcas pa rtse gcig gis 'bod do tha tshigs gis bskul 'o/ g.yar dam las ma g.yel bar dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang na bzhugs bzhugs sam rgya gar rdo rje gdan na bzhugs samaḥ yangs pa can dang na len+d+ra yi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs samaḥ sham bha la na bzhugs samaḥ 'o yug snye mo'i rdzongs na bzhugs samaḥ rdza'i ra ba chen po na bzhugs samaḥ gangs dkar seng ge gnam 'phyong na bzhugs

samaḥ 'o yug bum chung na bzhugs samaḥ rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nasaX sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir bzhengs shig gshegs shig byon cig badz+ra sa sa ma ya dza dzaḥspyan 'dren ni bas rgyal ba shākya thub o rgyan pad+ma yiḥ spyan sngar khas blangs bka' gter bstan pa srungaḥ snying thig 'od sku 'grub pa'i man ngag mtshog 'dzin srung spel ba'i gtsang btsan 'bar ba rtsal0 gangs dkar she ne sum brgya drug cu'i 'khoraḥ ma thog sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ yo badz+ra sadhu sarba sa ma ya dza dzaX bzhugs gsol niḥ hūṃ3ཿmnyes bskang dam rdzas bla rdo srog 'khor loḥ 'dod yon dgyes sprin dgra bsad dpa' skyems dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i rten rnams la skyes bu gtsang btsan 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsolaX mo badz+ra sa dhu sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan phyag 'tshal ni na mo dam tshig ldan pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad dngaX gtsug lag gnyan po chos 'khor dben sgrub gnasaX rtag tu sang sgob mdzad pa'i tha tshig can stes chen 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo shrī na ma ho mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ〉 ngo mtshar yid 'ong ltad mo rnam dag

ya snye1 pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang ja chang skyems phud zla rgyas zla phrum dang bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun dang ri dwags g.yunganor 'dab chags bya gcan dang dar zab 'bru sman go khrab mtshon cha dang brten sgrub rgyun gyi gtor mar bcud ldan pas skyes bu gtsang btsan 'khor bcas mnyes pa bskyedaphrin las gang 'dod grub pa'i byed po mdzodaḥyin badz+ra sa dhu sarba sa pa ri wa ra ma hā pu dza khā hiḥ bskang ba ni shā 'a yug gtsang btsan skyes bu thig le rtsal sman btsun yum gcigamached 'khor sprul par bcasaX mkhar thabs bshos bu ra yi mtshan pa dang sha khrag gtor ma rin chen brdar bas skyems snyug rgod khrab byang rnga khrab ra gsur dri mjes pamiglu gar rol mo sna tshogs dbyangs: spyan gzigs dkor cha dkod pas thugs dam bskangasaḥ bstod pa niḥhū snyi rgyal bami bstan srung mdo sngags zab bcud 'dzin lha mi 'jigarten khams la dbang mdzad pa bya ra seng gsum zhon pa'i skyes chen poḥ 'o yug gtsang btsan 'khor dang bcas la bstod phrin bcol ni rkyes rgyal ba kun dngo o rgyan pad+ma yi

thugs kyi 'od zer sing ge dbang phyug gis dri med bshes gnyen dgongs pa'i brda mdzod brnyes dwangs ma 'od lus grub pa'i sa ru phyin bstan 'gror phan pa'i thugs mthilasnying nor chosaḥ 'o yug gnas chen dag la bkod pa'i bab smon lam 'bras bzangasamed rnamasaganyis dang bdud 'dul mched lngasagasang bkrol phan bde yi dga' stonagadul bya'i dpal la 'gyed pa'i tshe0 bstan ston mdzad phrin gnyer skyongs dam mnos bzhin:rgyal mtshag sprul pa mi yi zol 'dzin pas zab tig yongs 'dus bī ma'i snyingathig bcud: smon lam 'brel bzang mthus bkrol bshad sgrub kyis kun bzang thugs bstan 'dzin srung spel ba'i dus: legs nyes so srung bstan pa'i zhabs tog sgrubs der 'dzin thugs mthun khrims gtsang rtogs rtsal rgyas sgyu lus dwangs ma'i 'od sku 'grub pa dang mi sdog kun tu 'od la byang chub shog nabar dbon khrod 'grims pa'i yonabadag gyis: 'tsho ba spyor la tshe dbang nyams rtogs bskyedaX lha 'dre mi gsum 'khor 'das rigs dbang bsdus 'jigs tshogs 'gal rkyen mi mthun kun zhi zhing gnyis snang

yas 1 log 'khrul bdud sde ming med rlog 'di phyi'i dpal yon dge mtshan snang ba bskyed skal ba rdzogs ldan nyin mo'i snang ba yisaḥ sa gsum ma lus kun khyab phrin las mdzodaX bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ bshags pa niḥ ho ye shes las grub mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bdagaX legs nyes stangs 'dzin gtsang btsan mched 'dzadar bcasaX bdag la brtser dgongs thugs dang 'gal ba'i lasaḥ ma lus mi 'chab snying nas 'gyod pas bshags: badz+ra sa ma yāḥ de ltar bsags spel sgrub pas 'bras phrin lasarnams bzhi thogs med 'grub 'phral phug kun tu dge legs rgyas the tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ngan lam rgyal mchog sprul pa yis 'o yug snyed mo'i brag dkar nas bī ma'i yang thig zab mo' skor snyesgom nam mkha'i dbang phyug gis dus bab sa mo yos kyi loraḥ ḍak+kis sprad pa 'i brda mdzod ni sred len dben pa'i gsang rgyud las bka' srung mchod phre zab mo 'di slob bu thub bstan dbang po la dag par phab ba ma loḥ

yas 1 lags pa sgrib bral thugs kyi me long niḥ a gdod nas dag pa'i rig pa chos sku la tha snyad gzung 'dzin spros pa ka dag kyangaḥ phral byung sems su bzung ba'igol sgrib rnams mtha' grol klong yangs thig le chen por bshagasaḥbacing grol med pa'i gnas lugs nam mkha' cheraḥ kun rmongs las kyi dri ma rnam dag kyangaX bdag nyidagacig pu lhan skyes kun btags kyiX dri ma sna tshogs chos kyi dbyings su bshagasaḥye nas sangs rgyas mnyam brdal de bzhin nyid phyogs dang ris med 'ub chub cher bzhugasakyangaX sems kyi mos ngor du ma so sor bzung 'khor 'das ris chad bltas pa mthol lo bshagasaḥbashags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang rlung sems rtogs ge'ispros pa dbu mar bzhag 'da' nyams srung mtshams las 'das rdzogs pa cheraḥ sor byang sngags sdom blo bral rjen par aX de ltar lta ba'i klong bshags 'dis chag nyams dri ma dbyings susangasaḥ sa ma yuḥreg 'jin 'ja' lusardo rje yisaḥ lce sgom chos kyi rdo rje la dam chos grol ba'i thig le yi zab mdzod bgo skal pha phog nyid dus tshigs gsum dang bcas te stsalaḥ rim bzhin rin chen shog skyar pheb ཿ 'di yang

dge rgan bi mdang chos bdag thub bstan dbang po yi re smon skong phyir nusaldan pas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bsgyur ba dge sarba ma la/mas 1 rtsa gsum dgyesabaskyed dzosabaskang ni yo a hūḥ ka dag rang rig rang gsal ba'iX ye shes sgron me 'od po che lhun grub 'bras mdzod mngon gyur phyir rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshor 'bulaḥ brdal khyab dbyings kyi bhan+ta ru 'gags med snang ba'i gtor chen bkodaḥ kun rtog chen 'dzin rang grol phyir rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshor 'bul bde stong klong yangs ka pā lar rten 'brel rnam dag rak+tas bkangaX chags 'khrul mtshan 'dzin ka dag phyir rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshor 'bul dum gcig dbyings phyug nor bu rtsa sha lnga bdud rtsi a dṛ gtams dngos kun ro mnyam grub pa'i phyir rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshor 'bul bza' ba tshogs pa'i dga' ston rnams rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'khor lor bskrun lhan skyes rtogs pa mngon gyur phyir rtsa gsum dgyes bskyed 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ 'khrul ba ka dag dngos grub stsolaḥ de ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib

༄rngo /ཿ dag don gnyis lhun gyi grub sa ma yāḥ lce sgom chos kyi rdo rje la rig 'dzan 'ja' lus rdo rje yas zab tig yang snying 'dus pa 'i skor man ngag mdzod rgya bgo skal sonaḥ bstan pa'i dus tshags gsum du bstan de ltar rgyal mchog bshad pa yis dge rgan dad ldan ni ma da ཿ chos bdag thub dbang dgyes pa'i phyir dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba masgo lamaḥgazhi1 tshogs bsdus ni ram̐ ye khaṃḥ sa ātuḥ 'og min bde ba chen po nas dbang chen rta phag yab yum 'khoraḥ 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs dga' ston 'dod yon dpal la rolaX chags sogs nyon mongs dri ma bshagasaḥ ma rtog nga bdag du dra bsgral mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bstabasaḥ 'khrul ba gzhi la sangs ba dngaḥbadag gzhan tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te0 nang dbyings bum skur byang chub thegagaḥ de ltar phul bas tshogs rdzogs shang nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang chos bdag blo gros rgya mtshogabaskul ngor nu ldan pas bres pa ma lam/

yas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ bla sgrub yid bshin nor bu'i tshogs mchod grub gnyis gter mdzod bzhugasaskragaḥ yarngo / na mo gu ru padha ka ra maḥ thamatshom(( rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las dpal pa d+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal skal ldan bsod nams tshogs rdzogs phyir ga ṇa tsakra'i thabs mchog bstan sa ma yu ma da na dang me sa dang bā la zhun me bdug pa sgos ci 'byor tshogs par byas nas su dum gcig la sogs snod du bsags dza gad skyems bza a kṛ btab sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs dang po ting 'dzin dbang bskur niḥ hrī brdal khyab yangs pa'i sgod kyi nang : bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigasaX tshogs su bkod la gnyis 'dzin gyiḥ mtshan 'dzin rtog pa re yo kho 67 las chosadabyings khyon mnyam pasaḥ a yis kun bzang tshogs mchod sprinaX sno gis 'dod yon phun tshogs gteraḥ hrīḥ yis lha tshogs dgyes bskyed gyur: gaḥhūṃ hrīḥbadz+ra sba ra ṇa khaṃ gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren niḥ hū hrīḥ mtha' bral dngas ma 'od kyi zhing lhun grub bde ba'i 'khor lo nasaḥ rtsa gsum dam can sras 'khor bcas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs

su gsolaX o badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaX gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba niḥ bla āXs bde gshegs kun 'dusapad+ma 'byungaḥ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sprin rab 'byams 'dod yon tshogs ladagyes par rolaX mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsolaḥ o ma hā pañtsa pu dza hoX bzhi pa dam skong gags pa niḥ nyo mnyam palitshogasardzas sna tshogs 'diḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i daladu 'bulaḥ dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ mi ldog rig 'dzin sa ru skyol sa badz+ra sa ma ya ā: lnga pa bsgral las bya ba niḥtrīḥ mtshan par 'jin paliganyis snang bdud mtshon chen shes rab ral gris bsgral phung po rdo rje 'bar bas gtams rnam shes skye med dbyings su drongs oṃ sarba du tra mā ra ya phaṭaḥ drug pa bstab mchod bya ba ni hrī ma rig ma ga 'khrul bsgral ba yiX dbang yum phung khams skye mched bcas rtsa gsum srung ma'i zhal du bstabs skye 'gag 'gyur med ngang du rolaḥ sarba du tra kha ram khā hiX bdun pa lhagam 'bul ba niḥ pheḥ stong nyid mkha' la dbang bsgyur zhingaḥ bstan la rtse zhing sgrub la gdung dbang phyug ma sring king laṅkaḥ pham phab 'di bzhes phrin las sgrubasaḥ ma ma byung ma ma

yas / ༷nga ba lirnyi kha kha khā hi kha hiX brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba niḥ hū hrīḥ ma bcosathig le'i klong yangs nas: rang snang 'od gsal bde ba'i skuḥ dgongs pa 1nga nas rab bskyod laḥ 'khrul ba gzhi ru sangs ba dngaḥ 'od skur grol ba'i las mdzod cig dgu pa chad mdo bstan ma ni bh+yoḥ rdo rje pad+ma thod phreng gisaX bka' nyan dam tshig 'dzin mdzad pa'i pho mo ma ni dregs pa'i tshogs: dpal mgon sde dpon dregs chen rnamasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ dam chos grol ba'i thig le yiḥ bstan pa srung la 'dus sde spelaX bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan gzhi 'dzug cing bkra shis dar rgyas che bar mdzodaX khyad par bod skyongs gnyer 'dzin mkhasaḥ ma yam bstan ma gtso 'khor bcas ཿbshal chu ba ling mchod pa bzhes bod khams chos kyi lam la sbyor smon log mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlogaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrug rgud pa sol bka' bzhin gnyer skyongs phrin las sgrubs chad don ma g.yel sa ma yāX r+sā pa bro mnan bya ba ni hrīḥ rang bzhin mnyam pa'i e klong duX log 'khrul dam sri 'byung po brubaḥ mnan no theg pa rim dgus rgyaḥ

nam yang sdang bar ma byed cig ma.uḥ/ swā hāstam bha ya nanaḥ bcu gcag pa bshad pa bya ba niḥ rdo gzung dang 'dzin pasabasdus pa yiḥ las nyon bag chags dri ma kun 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i klong mnyam nyid rig pas bshags bgyi'oḥ sa ma mā shudhe aX bcu gnyis pa bsngo ba smon lam niḥ hoḥ dus gsum bsagasapa'i dge tshogs kun ཿ 'khor gsum mnyam nyid dbyings su bsngo 'khor ba srid pa'i sems can rnamasaḥ gdod ma'i sku gsum sa thob shog bcu gsum rtag pha mtha' bsal ni sa sgod ba da sgyu ma dbyings sdud bzhin thig le nyag gcig klong du hūṃḥ slar yang thugs rje'i rol rtsal las rjes thob phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor spyodaX a āḥ phaṭā phaṭāX r+sā bzhi shis bo da bya ba ni na mo dngosagrub kun kyi 'byung gnas mchog bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shogaX gang la bsam pa'i don kun grubaḥ ma hā gu ru'i bkra shis shog bde stong 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings ma rgyud pakha' 'gro'i bkra shis shogaX bdud dpung zil gnon phrin las sgrubaX dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shogaX thog ma bar dang mtha' dge b.raX zab tig snying po'i bkra shis

sa shā 1 31ga bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab bkra shis shog dge ston rgya chen bya bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par 'gyur bar chad g.yul las rnam par rgyal don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur/sa ma mā zed len med pa'i brda risani lce btsun brag dkar sgom chung las lha sman dkar sham she le yis gces nor rig pa'i ga'ur sim lha btsun rgyal mchog sprul pas rnyed chos sred bor ba'i rnal 'byor ba btsun pagasum dang sngags skyes lngas brda bkrol bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ bdo thim lha chos 'di la las smon rten 'brel gyi dbang skal 'dzom pa thub bstan dbang phyug gis lha gos dri bral dang / bde b.ragashegs pa' rten sna 'phrul bzos ris su brisapa da / dam chos yi ge 'byung ba'i dzos mtshal snags bzang po ra/ bsgrub brtson gyi me tog sogs kyi skyes nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ pad+ma lce btsun nam mkha' dbang phyug gsadag pa ra phab pa dge legabada'aphel/ sarba masgo le/

yas 1 — dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiX zab tig yang snying 'dus pa las: bla sgrub yid bzhin nor nu'i don bskang pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so:yas 1 na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye bcasha tham/ rgyal kun gsang 'dzin pa d+ma 'byung mthon mthing ral bas btud de 'dud snang srid 'dod yon bskang rdzas kyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes par byaḥ sa ma māḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ka dag dang ma'i 'od klong nas dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ 'od gsal bde ba chen po nas brda brgyud bla ma'i 'bad med lhun grub pho brang nas snyan brgyud bla ma'i pad sdong las byon ye shes skuḥ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i mi mjed phrag brgya'i skyabs gcig pu snang srid zil gnon o rgyan yul kun chos la bkodaḥpad+ma rgyal po'i lhun grub brtsegs par zab don brnyesaḥ nyi ma 'od zer bde byed brtsegs par zab rgya bkrolaḥ seng ge sgra sgrogs pra bha hastir rab tu byung blo ldan mchog sred thugs mdo sngags bstan pa dar rgyas mdzadaḥ shākya seng ge'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ zab gter bstan 'gro'i btsas su bzhag rdo rje gro lod thugs dam log 'dren rgol

ngan rdul brlag pa'i sharnyi rak+ṣa'i bde stong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje bo: ā tsar+ya gzhen ma rung srin po chos la bkodaḥ thod phreng rtsal gyi rnga yab pad+ma 'od gling nasaX pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs yang dag thugs kyi rig 'dzin paḥ hūṃ chen ka ra'i 'jam dpal sku yi rig pa 'dzinaḥ mnyu mi tra'i pad+ma gsung gi rig klu sgrub snying po'i phrin las phur pa'i pra chen hasti'i thugs dam bde stong ma mo'i dha na sid+ma'i thugs dam rig 'dzin yongs rje bder 'dus dpal bi ma mi tra'i 'jig rten mchod bstod rig pa 'dzinaḥ rasbu gu rgya'i dmod pa drag sngags rig pa 'dzinaXshirnyi ghasnye'i phrin las lhun grub dkyil 'khor nasaḥ mkha' 'gro yab yum tshad med lasakyi da la nas ging chen sde bzhi'i bka' nyan dam tshig gnyan la gdungaḥ pho nya yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ / hrīḥ nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lngaX sman gtor rak+ta gsang ba'i rdzas phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis rtsa rgyud blama'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ dngos po chos nyid yangs par bskangasaX 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du bskangs bskang bya skong byed dag pas

yas 1 bskangasaX ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po sathams cad dag chen chos skur bzhag de ltar bskang bas tshogs pho ོgas sgrib dag was rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas don gnyis lhunagyis 'grub par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥsam māḥsamo ma kyisame khams 'brug rten 'brel dus tshags dang po'oḥbade sbyin spre 'u'i shes rab rgya leg pa med pa'i brda sgo phyes snye btsun gnyer mared brag dkaraseng sbas bkrol rgyal mchog sprul pa niḥlce sgom chos kyi rdo rje yis mtshan chos sred bor chos bdag laḥlcags 'brug ral brgya'i 'dab ma lngaḥ.a ta rang byung 'od lnga 'khrigs dbang chen sprel zla'i tshes grangs la rten 'brel kunatshogs rdzas lnga dang sgrub pa'i me tog bzang pos bskul rin chen shog skyar bkod pa'oḥdage'o legs so masgo lam/yas 1 tshogs bsdus ni re yi khoḥ āḥhūṃX 'og min mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i glingaḥdhu ma tha la'i grong khyer nasaXḍak+ki'i tshogs rje rnal 'byor maḥ'abum phrag yangasapa'i 'khor dang bcasaḥ'adu ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegasaḥg ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa bzhesaḥchag nyams sems kyi dri ma bshagasaX nga bdag mtshan ma rū tra bsgral yeshes

gsang ba'i klong du stobasaḥ khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs shing sgyu lus 'od sku 'grub pa dngaX thog ma'i sangs rgyas mngon gyur shog de ltar phul bsargas pho rdzogs sgrib dgadon gnyis lhun gyisathubaḥ sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ/ zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin blo rgyasan bkrashis dge ba'i skyesabacas bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo ldan pa lab maṅga lam/

yas 1 — dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥzab tig yang snying 'dus pa las yi dam sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs soḥ 42 1 na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye zas /zugs rgyalakun phran lasagacig bsdus pa pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshalaḥbargyud bdebs byin rlabs gter mdzod 'ad mos gus drag po sa brjod par byaḥ e ma hoḥ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum dang lhun grub rol pa rigs lnga'i gangs can mtsho sgyu 'phrul gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje laX gsol ba 'debs so 'od sku grub byin rlobasaX mkhyen brtse'i gter chen 'char ga'i gzi mdangs can snying rje'i dbang phyug dri med shel dkar mdogaX mi mjed skyabs mgon o rgyan chen po laX gsol ba 'debs so 'od sku grub byin rlobs mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal maḥ dbang gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dartengs dngaḥ thugs sras rje rgyal 'bangs 'khor nyer lnga laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dkyil 'khor gtso mchog rgyal kun gsung gsang garaḥ ma rig rā tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags can rta skad 'dul glus 'dor ba

dbyings sgrol la gsol ba 'debs so byin dpa' bo dgyes bskyed shes rab btsun mo'i gzugs glu lnga bton pas dug lnga dbyings la sbyoraḥ bde chen pad+mor mtshan bcasasdud pa mor gsol ba 'debs so dbang phyug gnas yul bzhi spyor he ru ga phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul mthar byed yab yum dang mjang yul za byed mnyam sbyor yab yumabacuraḥ gsol ba 'debs so dus 'dzin gshed bsgyur spor ma bcu drug dngaX phrin las bzhi sgrub sgo skyongs yab yum brgyadaX rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan pho nya dam can la gsol ba 'debs so 'phral rkyen mtha' dag bzlog phyi yi du tra yul med zang thal ngangaḥ nang gi du tra bdag med mnyam pa'i klongaḥ gsang ba'i rū tra gzhi med rtsa bral dbyings kun khyab chos sku'i klong la rtag bsgral nas dbang chen he ru ka dpal mngon gyur re gaX de ltar gsol ba btab ba'i mi phyi nang rkyen las rnam par grol nyams rtogs nyi zla'i zer bzhan rgyas don gnyisagegs mes 'grub par 'gyur sa ma shāḥ dpal sred len bral ba'i bdo mdzod las dengangan lam rgyal mchog sprul pas rted mgon 'ja' lus rdo rjes gtad rgya son skab rten 'brel mthu bzang 'bras bu de las dbang skal
risang / 'dzom pa thub dbang ngorakho lce sgom nam mkha'i dbang byugagis brda dag par phab pa masgo la

yas 1 dam chosagrol ba'i thig lesnyiḥzab nyig yang snying 'dusapa lasaḥyi dam rta phag yab yum gyi sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs soḥgs / na thoguru pa d+māka ra ye zas ma rab 'byam rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu pa d+ma 'byu gnas la phyag 'tshal ma 'o sa las lngan don ched du shin tu zab pa 'i snying thig skor ཿbyin rlabs ya mtshan che ba rnams bcud dral snying po' man ngag brtanaḥs ma wāḥsgrub rdzas tsas dkar po yiḥphur pa rtse sor gsum tshad bya g.yu byang rdo rje shog zur brgyad tsan+dan dmar pa'i kha tswa ni tshad ni gong bzhin mdzes par bya byu ru' dril bu ba pa dkar dmar dar gyi dral byas nas 'thu tshom khar 'khod nyer spyod bkram phyi nang dam rgya bsdams byas nas bsnyen sgrub gzhung bgrangs don gnyas 'grubaḥs ma yu skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed ni na 31ཿthams cad mnyam nyid rig pa chos kyi sku0 don dam mnyam nyid lha la skyabs su mchiḥ'akhrul ba sems rtsal snang ba bag chags bcasaḥgadod ma'i gzhi la sangs phyir sems bskyed do0 lan gsumaḥbaka' bsgo niḥhrīḥ'akhor 'das mi byed thig le nyag gcig laḥbagegs bdud mtshan ma'i spros pa rnam dag kyang 'phral rtog ma rig las nyon 'khrul ba'i

bgegs rang grol glud gtor 'di longs dbu mar dengasaḥ bsrung gur na trīḥ ma brtsal rdzogs ldan chos sku chen po phu srung dang bsrung bya gnyis su mi dmigs kyangaX kun khyabadagongs pa g.yo med mngon gyur phyiraḥ byang chub sems kyi rwa gur yongs su dkrigs: byin 'bebs niḥ shā sdiḥ mtshan rtog sprosabral bde stong klong yangs nas rgyal kun gsangamachog rta phag zhal sbyor garaḥ gnyis snang bdud 'dul ro mnyam dgongs rtogs byir mi 'gyur kun bzang dbang byin 'dir stsol cigaḥ mja sa byin bapos niḥtrīḥ mtha' bral snang ba rab mdzes chos nyid khyonaḥ yongs su khyab brdal yul drug bkod pa'i sprin spang blang mi dmigs bde chen rol pas brgyanaḥ nam mkha' mdzod kyi dpal yon bla na med de ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o sa ma yu ting 'dzin rnams gsum niḥ snyenaḥ gzod nas ma bcos mtha' bral nam mkha' cheḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal snying rjes yongs su gang zung 'jug mdangs las rig rtsal hrīXbamaḥniḥ ma skyes mi 'gags mkha' la 'ja' bzhin 'byugasaḥ lha bskyed niḥ trīḥ brtan g.yo'i snang ba chos nyid 'khor lor 'dres lcan grub 'od snang sprul ba'i

ra 1 zhing bkod ni ma chags pad+ma dbang gi dal du rdzogasaḥ dpa' bo yab yum mnyam par rol ba'i mdangasaX tshogs yul rnam dag dur khrod bkod par shar rang byung thod mkhar brda don rtags rdzogs pa'iḥ bkod pa rab 'byams ma 'dres dal dbus su 'dod 'byung rat+na'i khri steng thabs shes rabaḥ gnyis med nyi zla zung 'jugabadud bzhi 'i kharaḥ rang rig ngo bo dpal chen rtsa ba'i laX snang ba thabs chen rta mgrin dbang gi skuḥ dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i gzi 'od 'byugs ༷ khro gtum rngam 'chad bltar mi bzod pa'i nyamasaX zhal gdangs ljags 'dril sbyan bsgrad mche bzhi gtsigs ཿ ha ha hūṃ phaṭā nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogasaḥ dur khrod dpal chas sku yi rgyan du klubasaḥ rus rgyan me yi 'od chen phyogs su 'phro zhabs rnams bsgrad pa'i bdud dpung zil gyis gnon snang stong ma 'dres sa ler bkra ba'i zhalaḥ skye shi rtsad gcod gri gug mkha' la phyar rmongasatshogs zil gnon sbrul gyi zhags pa bsdamasaḥ bde ba'i mdangs sbyin shes rab phag mo yum be+eḍūr mdangs 'khyud dmar ser ral pa 'khyalaḥ gzig sham g.yang gzhi rus

rgyan dar dpyangs brgyanaḥ zhi ma khro 'dzum stong gsal 'od kyi sku zhabs g.yon yab 'byud g.yas pas 'khor ba gnon bde stong mnyam sbyor drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs rigasamatshan ru hra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags su rta ljang phag nag dbu yi ral mtshams mdzesaḥregs kyibadag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ he ru ka pa phyed skyil gri thod 'dzin0gyirem khrag 'thung dpa' bo yab yum brgyad dkar ser dmar ljang bde stong nyams la spyod las mdzad ging bzhi rus pa'i gzugs can laḥ ru mtshon cod pan rnge'u chung tir tir brdungadapa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'thibs bzhin sdud bka' nyan lo nya klu bdud gza' sngags bdag phrin las byed po las kyi lha ru sharaḥbar mtshams dza dachung dam can pho mornams ma 'dres 'od sku 'ja' yi rang bzhin gsalaḥ gnas gsum 'od kyis rgyal kun thugs rgyud bskul0 spyan drangs gnyis med bde ba chen por bsreḥ spyan 'dren niḥsdi ma bams gartang gsal 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor nas lhun grub bde ba'i sku can lhag pa'i lha rta phag zhal sbyor sprul pa 'khor dang bcasaḥ dbyings las bzugs kyi rgyar bzhengs

yas 1 'dir gshegs shigaḥ bzhugs gsol niḥ hrīḥ thugs rje'i lcags kyus dbyings nas drangs ba'i lhaḥ byams pa'i zhags pas rten la mnyam par sbyoraḥ dga'aba'i sgrogs gis gnyis su med par bsreḥ btang snyoms dril bus brtan par bzhugs su gsol phyag 'tshal ni na 33 kun khyab nang dbyings rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha'aḥ bde chenathabs mchog dpa' bo yab kyi garaḥ gnyis med rol rtsed 'khor 'das banyam nyid mdzad don dam 'dus ma byas la phyag 'tshal loḥ mchod pa ni hṝ bdag rtog du tra gzungaba'i ma tram̐ daḥ mnyam rol shes rab mtshon chas bsgral ba lasaX dbang yul phung khams skye mchod don snying dngaḥ sna tshogs 'dod yon bkod pa ma 'dres bzhinaḥ gang shar rangagrol rgyan rdzogs pu dza yang rta phag bde sbyor gsang gsum dal du 'bul bdag med 'ub chub chen por bzhes nas kyangaḥ 'khor 'das dag pa rab 'byams rtogs pa spor kun bzang thugs mchog g.yo med dngos grub stsol bstod pa niḥ hu hrīḥ khams gsum bde spyor mnyam pa nyid sku chos nyid 'gyur med brjod bral sngags kyi sgraḥ gang shar rang

grol kun bzang bde ba'i thugs dbang gi rgyal po h+ya gh+ri war bstod 'dzab dmigs niḥtrī bdag snang dpa' bo rta mgrin thugs ka ru pha lam rdo rje'i lte bar nyi zla'i sbubasaḥrig pa triḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskoraḥ bzlas pas bde dang stongs pa'i 'od gsal 'baraḥ snang grags rig gsum phyag rgya chen po'i ngang gyes hri rba rgya skṛ wa ma hā su kha sarba sirnyi 〉ཿ yengs med ting 'dzin brtan po yis 'byu 'bum bzlos pas rtags mtshan 'charaḥ sa ma yu sgrub 'dzab ni rang nyid lha gsal thugs ga'i sngags phreng lasaḥ 'od zer dbang mdog yab yum zhal gsang 'khor dga' stong mchog tu mi 'gyur 'od gsal rgyas dbang bzhi cig char thob la sgrib kun dag: gang snang ma bcos dbang chen yab yum dalaḥ zung 'jug drag polidakyil 'khor bde ba che'oḥ skyos sdi baṃḥrgya skṛ wa wa ra hi sto dhi tsat+ta ma hā su kha sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ bzlasapa dbugs kyi rta la drangs ting 'dzan spro bsdu'i 'khrul 'khor bslabaḥs lam nyams rtogs rtsal chen rdzogs don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar 'byuraḥ sa ma yuḥ las sbyor ni bdag nyid lhar gsal sku yi cha rnams lasaX 'od zer me 'od mtshon cha'i tsha tsha spros mi dang mi min 'byung po

ra 1 dam sri bsgralaḥ tshe dpal nyams rtogs yon tan lo 'dab rgyas rlung sems rtogs tshogs rig pa rang dbang bsdusaḥ gnyis snang dri ma chos kyi dbyings su zhi gang 'dod phrin las thogs med yid bzhin 'byungaX bde stong rta phag gnyis med dgongs pa'i ngangaḥ trīḥbo rgya snyi wa sarba duṣ+ṭa shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa ting 'dzin g.yo med gdengs ldan pas bzlas pa chu bo'i gzhungasaltar bya mi rang rtags mtshan bzang por bcas dngos grub mtshan ma brnyes par 'gyuraḥ sam yāḥ daro sa gzhi'i las rim tshang ba'oḥ rgya rgya rgya dngos grub bskul ba ni kye hoḥ bde steng spros bral 'od gsal klong yangs nas ma skyes 'jigs med dpa' bo gar gyi dbangaX dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lhag pa'i lhaḥ pad+ma dbang gi bdag nyid rta phag zungaX yang yang bsnyen grub las sbyor mtha' ru phyinaḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan pa'i dus la bab ༷ thugs la le lo btang snyoms mi mdzad paraḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub deng 'dir stsol ༷ rol mo'i sgra da snyan pa'i glus kwa ya sirnyi skye wāk+ka sidhi ā tsit+ta sirnyi(ཿ sarba sirnyi trī brgya rtsa la sogs brjod pa'i rjes rtong tshig gis ni mchod bstod bya byin dbab sman mchod bro bshags

bya de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni mdun bskyed kyilha tshogs rnams rjes chags kyis sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams dngaX gnas bzhi las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang gi rnamapar byungaX bdag bskyed kyi gnas bzhir thim pas sgrub bya dang bsgrub byed dbyer med du gyur bar bsam laḥ / trīX bdegashadags ma lus 'dus pa'i sku'iX dbang dang dngosagrub 'dir stsol cigaḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ dbang chen gsung godakyil 'khor nas bde stong 'gag med dngos grub stsolaḥwāk+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa āḥmanyam nyid mtha' bral dkyila'akhor nasaḥ ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsol tset+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉༷ khyab brdal migayo mgon po yiḥ dbang byin dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal 'dzad med gter chen bum pabazangaḥ yid bzhin re skong 'gro 'dul mthu0 thun mong grub brgyad khyad par duX rig 'dzin bzhi bsgrod dbang dngos grubaX rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bdag cag laḥ da lta nyid dustsol bar mdzod sarba a snyi ྅༷ trī sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams kun la spyod snod min rnamasal sbyin mi bya mtha' rten shis brjod dga' ston bya des ni dngos grub thob par 'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥ rjesakyi lasarim tshang ba'o rgya

ra cho1 rgya rgya rgyal kun dgongs bcud snying tig 'di sred len bral ba'i brda mdzod ni 'o yug snyi yi me lo dang 'o yug stag mgo'i bum chung dpal 'o yug brag dkar seng chung la ba ma'i snying tig skor nyer lnga zab mo' gter du rnams par bkod lce btsun dngas ma'i 'od skur gshegs dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na ngan lam rgyal mchog sprul pa niḥ ragasasngags 'chang ba' rnal 'byor ba gsal byed dbang po bya bar 'phrad 'gro don phrin las rgya chen 'byung de bar srungs shig sngagasabadag moḥ sa ma māḥ kha tham las smon bzang 'dzom thub bstan dbangaḥ gang gis sgrub pa 'i me tog bcas nan bskul dus tshigs dang po ni lcags babrug ral brgya'i 'dab ma la rin chen shog skyar bkod pa dge sarba ma lamaḥ

yas / dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiX zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ yi dam sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs bsags dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs thegaḥ 4211 — na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye za1shānasha ba rgyal kun ye shesagacag bsdus dpal pad+ma 'byu gnas la phyag 'tshal ya dam rta phag yab yum kyi dgyes bskyed tshog bsags thabs chen bstanaḥ sa ma mā bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams kun dum gcag bhasnyo'i snod nang bsags rang nyid lha gsal ting 'dzan gyis tshogs gtor byan gyis brlabs pa niḥ hrī gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus snang ba'i chos rnams kun ma bshams ye rdzogs tshogs kyi bkod par gnasaX phyi nang gnyis med ting 'dzin dag pa yis ro mnyam 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal yon gyur tshogs zhing spyan 'dren niḥ hrīḥ chags bral bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas bcom ldan pad+ma gsung mchog rol pa'i lhaḥ rta phag zhal sbyor bdud dpung zil gnon rtsalaḥ rang snang 'od gsal dga' ston dpal spod phyiraX 'du ba tshogs la span 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ mtshan 'dzin sbos dang bral phyir tiṣ+ṭha lhan tshogs phud 'bul ba niḥ hri: kun rdzob mtshan ma

chos skur sangs ba'i phyir rten 'brel ro mnyam dga' ston tshogs la rolaḥ ye nas ma bcos thig le nyag gcig gisaḥ dkyil 'khor he ru ka dpal mngon gyur stsolaḥ bar bshags niḥ hoḥ gdod nas 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes klongaḥ yod med phyogs 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' kun bral 'da' nyams srung mdzams las 'das rdzogs pa cheraḥ gnyis 'dzin sems kyi nongs pa ma lus 'chagasaḥ bsgral las niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ma rig bdag tu lta ba'i du tra rnams shes rab mtshon cha 'bar bas rab bsgral nas rnams shes skye med yum gyi mkha' la sparaḥ phung khams skye mched sha khrag tshogs su gyur bstab pa ni hrīḥ bde chen rol pa rta phag yab yum la dam nyams bsgral ba'i chos khams mchod pa 'bul mnyam pa nyid kyi klong du dgyes rol nasaX khams gsum dbyings sgrol sku gsum mngon gyur shog lhag ma na pheḥ chos nyid stong pa rdo rje'i dgongs srog canaX dam tshig shugs 'chang sgrub pa'i drod tshad nyul dbang phyug ma sring ki lang 'bar ma rnams pham phab 'di bzhes brin las gang bcol sgrubasaX u tsi ṭa bha lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi chad tho ni hūṃ smo

yas 1 bskal pa thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad duḥ spyi dpal he ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sogasaX grub brnyes rig 'jin brgyud pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar khas blangs mna' bor dregs tshogs dang khyad par rang snang 'od gsal dag pa'i ngor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'ja' lus rdo rje yisaḥ snying thig zab mdzod mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i chos sred len bral ba brda yi ring bsrel lasaḥ brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bab pa'i dus tshigs gteraḥ tshogs smon las 'phro'i zhing bzang gso smin tsheḥ bka' nyan pho nya'i gnyer blang dam mnos bzhinaḥ sgo 'dir spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnamasaḥ dngas ma'i 'od lus mi ldog sar spyod pa'i phrin las yang rtse 'od gsal snying po'i lam gegs med sgrub pa mtha' ru 'khyol ba'i phyiraḥ brngan mchod bzhes la tha tshig mdo rtsa bzhin: grub par mdzod cig badz+ra sa ma yā: bstan ma ni bh+yo nam mkhar dbang rgyu legs nyes sa srung ba brtan ma skyongs mdzad ma sring 'khor 'bangs bcas 'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma'i brngan bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan srung sems phan bde

spel: khyad par 'od gsal zab tig bcud 'dus pa'i: bstan pa srung la 'dus sde dar rgyas mdzod bkra shis snang ba bskyed cig sa ma yāḥ rta bro niḥ trīḥ rang bzhin bde stong mnyam pa'i 'od 1nga du log 'khrul gnyis snang dam sri 'byung po brub nam yang ldang med byang chub sems rgyas 'debs sku gsum mngon gyur bar du ma 'da' zhig ༅gas paniḥ hoḥ gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin dri mas bslad pa las kun bzhi ma rig rdul 'dres bag chags kunaX rang snang 'od gsal bde ba chen por bshagasaḥ rgya grol rig pa mngon gyur ye bab ngangaX bsngo smon na hoḥ zag dang zag med dge ba ci bsags pa kun khyab ye shes chen po'i ngang du bsngoḥ khams gsum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo dbyings su zhig ka dag don gyi sku gsum mngon gyur shogaḥ bsdu ldang niḥ āḥ thabs chen bkod pa snang stong zung 'jug gi dkyil 'khor ma lus mtha' bral chos skur bsduX slar yang ye shes thug rje'i rang mdangs suḥ rang grol lta ba gyad kyi spyod lam bya'o shisabarjod ni na mo sku gsum lhun grub don dam gnyug ma'i gshis snang grags 'gyu gsum rig pa ye shes lamaX

42 1 gang shar rang grol kun bzang klong yangs bab mnyam brdal rdzogs pa chen po'i bkra shis shog bsngo smon shis brjod mthar rgyas bya tshogasardzogs sgrib dag don gnyisa'agrub bde stong dpa' bo yab yum kyi dgongs pa zang thal mdo na du gyuraḥ sa ma yā rjes kya las rim tsha ba'o rgya rgya rgya ngan lam rgyal mchog sprul pa ni gsal byed sur+ya'i dbang bo la dus sad sa mo yos kyi lor thub chen 'ja' lusardo rje yis brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bab bstan tshe gangs dkar lha mo dam 'dzin mas sred len bral ba'i brda bstan tshe lce sgom nam mkha'idabang phyug gis las slob btsun pa thub dbang gis sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan dge ba'i skyes bzang po du ma bcas bskul ngor lcagasa'abyug dus tshigs thog ma la ran chen shog skyar bkod pa'oḥ dge'o legs so maṅga leḥ

shus 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lelhaḥ zab rtag yang snyeng 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'idan bskang dngul dkar me long bzhugasadresaḥ yas / na mo gu ru paṅgā ka ra ye zagaza'irta rgyal kun she shesardo rje che pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshalaḥ las ldan 'dzom pa'i skyes bu yi tshogs gnyis bre kha bkang ba'i phyir dpa' bo rta phag zhalasbyor ba'i dgyes bskang bsod nams chu gter bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ snang srid 'khor 'das gnyagasu med mnyam nyid rtogs pas bskang bar bya rkyeḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas tha mi dad pa'i zhal kun bzang migayo mgon po'i thug dam bskangs srid zhi mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i mdangs rnam snang gangs chen mtsho yi thugs dam bskangs rigs mtshan spros rtogs gnyis med bde ba'i dpalaḥ gsang bdag rdo rje chos kyi thugs dam bskangasaḥ gnyis snang rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags canaḥ rta skad rngam gshad sgrogs pa'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ ma ga spyor dus mtshan chung ma dbyings sbor ba'iḥ phag skad dur sga 'byin ba'i thugs dam bskangs dbang phyug gnas yul ma mo bde bas sboraX dus mtshan he ru ka yi thugs dam

bskangs phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul sa lam mchog la 'godaX mthar byed chen po bcu yi thugs dam bskangs phyogs lnga'i 'byangs la yul gyi za byed rnamasaḥ mnyam rol yabayum bcu yi thugs dam bskangs dus 'dzin de gshed bsgyur ba'i brtul zhugs canaḥ spor ma bcu drug shar ba'i thugs dam bskangs brin las bzhi sgrub tshad med shugs ldan pa'i pho nya sgo bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskangs rlung gi shugs can sgrol ba'i thogs med mdelu bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ hrīḥ gzung ba rnam dag phyi yi mchod pas bskangasaḥ 'dzin pa rang grol nang gi mchod pas bskangasaX kun bzhi mnyam nyid gsang ba'i mchod pas bskangasaḥ dug gsum rab sgral sman gtor rak+tasabaskangasaḥ snang gsal bde rig stong sbyor thugs dam bskangasaX blo ngan gnyis rtog bsgral bas thugs dam bskangasaḥ chos nyid mnyam pa chen pos thugs dam bskangasaX chos can rgyan gyi bkod pas thugs dam bskangasaX thab chub ting 'dzin mchod pas thugs dam bskangasaḥ mtha' bral lta ba dag pas thugs dam bskangs dri med zang thal sgom pas

ཿsa / thugs dam bskangasaḥ rnam rgyal 'dzin med spyod pas thugs dam bskangs bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag cesas dbyings lhug par āḥ de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag phrin las lhun gyis grub tshe dbang nyams rtogs 'phel zhing rgyas don gnyas lhun grub the tshom medaḥ sa ma māḥngan lam rgyal mchog sprul pa yas chos bcud mdo khams gsham du drangs sred len bral ba'i brda mdzod ni ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbyings nas bskulaḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i thabs su sgrogs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gnad zab skor dbang lung man ngag gtad rgya son de yi rten 'brel mthu bzang po lce sgom nam mkha'i dbang phyug gis snying nor mthun sbyor bya btang ba thub bstan dbang por phab pa'o dus gsum kun nas dge ba dang thog mthar bar gsum bkra shis shogaḥ dza yan+tu

4)cho/ bskang rdzas byin brlabs niḥ ho yul drug 'dod yon snang ba'i gteraX thams cad rgyan gyi bye brag steḥ kun bzang mnyam nyid rol pa'i rdzas ཿ nam mkha' mdzod kye 'phrodar ma ra spelaḥ sngags dang phyag rgyas byan gyis brlabs 'di' nye bar mkho ba'i phyir lce sgom nam mkha'i dbang phyug gis legs pa phab pa make la yas 1 gnam phud bska ba mi hūṃ trī gting gsal thig le'i klong yangs nasaḥ bla ma rgya mtsho tshogs la rolaḥ snying dbus dpal ri'i pho brang nasaX rang rig bla ma tshogs la rolaḥ snang srid gzhir bzhengs dkyil 'khor nasaX yi dam rgya mtsho tshogs la bde stong nyi zla kha sbyor nasaḥ pad+ma dbang chen tshogs la rolaḥ rnams kun mtshog ldan dkyil 'khor nasaḥ dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro tshogs la rolaḥ che phra dwangs ma lnga klong nas rdo rje phag mo tshogs la rolaḥshes rab phra ba'i 'od klong nasaḥ ye shes mtsho rgyal tshogs la rolaḥ dam tshig gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin paḥ ma mgon lcam dral tshogs la rolaḥ grol thig bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa gtsang bzan mched 'khor tshogs la rol phya nang

gsang ba de kho na lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rig stong rjen grol tshogs chen pos rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskangasaX bskang gyur rtogs pa mngon gyur shogaḥ de ltar dgyes bskyed bskang ba'i thabs rig 'dzan 'ja' lus rdo rje yas ste sgom chosakya rdo rje la bgo skal pha phog tshur du nod re zhig sbasargya bsdams mod kyad rten 'brel dusal bab pa'i tshe dge rgan khro gtum bu ma dang chos bdag 'dor zhig thub dbang ngor rgyalamachog bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis chu lug zla 3 tshes 25 bzang por spelaḥ sarba maṅga la

ya/nga 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥzab tig yang snying 'dus pa las mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs ter bcud bzhugs soḥyas 1 na mo gu ru padha ka ra yaḥ shāskis rgyal ba kun gyi phran las gzugs bā ma mi drwa la phyag 'tshal dad ldan mos gus 'byor ba yas 'phags ma gsal btab gsol gdab ni ye ma hoḥgadod nas ma skyes bde chen kun bzang moḥdabyer med klong yangs rnal 'byor wa ra hiXmakhyen gnyis dbang phyug ngag dbang dbyangs can maraX gsol ba 'debs so sku gsum mngon gyur stsolaX gangasasdongs skyabasagacig dzñā na sa ra bye bde ba'i 'byung gnas ka la sirnyi dang dri med zla zhal shākya dhe wa laXgasol ba 'debs so bde stong mngon gyur shogaX shes rab me chen bkra shis khe 'dren dngaḥrgyal ba kun yum lha lcam man+ta raX rdo rje bde sbyin ngang byung dpal btsun laḥgasol ba 'debs so bde stong mngon gyur shogaḥdagyes pa'i zhal bzang rdo rje mgon skyid dngaḥganas yul dur khrod he ru'i mkha' 'gro maḥzhing rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor laḥgasol ba 'debs so bde

stong mngon gyur shog 'o yug gtsang btsan rdo rje 'bar ba rtsalaX gsang chen gnyer 'dzin gangs dkar she ne smanaḥ bya seng ra zhon sum brgya drug cu laX gsol ba 'debs so phrin las lhun grub shogaḥ de ltar dbyings kyi yum chen rnal 'byer ma'iḥ dkyil 'khor lha la rtse gcig gsol btab mthus khreg chod thod rgal lam gyi rtsal rdzogs nasaḥ ye shes rtse mo 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sar nges don mngon par byang chub mchog thob shogaḥ de ltar gsol ba bawa pa yis tshe bsod nyams rtogs pon ma 'phel 'phral rkyen ngan pa kun las grol the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yuḥ rgyal mtshog spu pa'i skyes chen gyis dus bab sa mo yos kyi lor 'o yug brag dkar bya ba'i bcud 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gtad rgya bkrolaḥ snesgom nam mkha'i dbang phyug gas lcags 'byug ral brgya'i 'dab ma la rin chen shog skyar bkod pa yis thubabartan dbangapo mnye gyur cig de 'bras sgrub rgyud 'dzin nus pa'i dge mtshan 'phel rgyas maṅga leḥ dza yan+tu

yas / dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiX zab nyag yang snyeng 'dusapa lasaḥmakha' 'gro'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs soḥyas 1 na rmo gu ru padh+waka ra ye za za ts+tsha/ rgyalakun she she rdo rje che pad+ma 'byung gnasal phyag 'tshalaḥm 'ongs las ldan pho mo la man ngag zab pa'i mthil gcig bstanaḥs ma māḥd na gan rgyu 'grul bral ba ru ཿphyin te phyi nang dam rgya sdoms maṇ+ḍal zlum po mdzes tshon bya bla rdo shel dkar zur brgyad pa ཿna pa ṇi gson ma dang g.yu byang mig med srog gi rten bla rdo gtor ma sman raka sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byadabasags khrus dang gtsang sbra nan du bya mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig med gcig phyal lhun grub chen po mi bsrung ba'i srung ba srog gi gtang ru 'dzinaḥs ma māḥskyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na 31snye 'gag 956ra med ye rdzogs mkha' 'gro'i zhal gnyis med don dam yum la skyabs su mchiḥ'akhrul ba lu gu rgyud 'phyang gzung dang 'dzin 'pho med chos skur sangs byir sems bskyed do lanagasum bka' bsgo niḥtrīḥrnam rtog mtshan ma'i gdon bgegs ngoms byas phyiraX rang grol 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor bzhes khro chen rdo rje gar gyi rwa ba 'dir ཿ'da' ba'i

skal med dbu ma chen por dnges bsrung gur niḥ trīḥ thams cad mnyam nyid chos sku'i dkyil 'khor laḥ bgegs bdud mtshan ma'i spros pa rnam dag kyangaX 'phral byung semasab rtog bdud las rgyal ba'i phyir0 gzhom med byang chub sems kyi gur khang dkrigasaX byin 'beb niḥ trīḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las bde stong dga' char thugs rje ye shes mdangasaX kun rdzob mtshan ma'i chos kun byin brlabs nas gdod nas rnam dag dkyil 'khor gsum ldan gyur mja rdzasabyin b.los niḥ ཿhrīḥ ma brtsal rang byung yul drug sprul snang ba ngo mtshar ltad mo phyi nang gsang bkod rnams zhen med rang grol kun bzang bkod pa ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor yongs su spelaḥ de ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'oḥs ma yuḥting 'dzin rnams gsum niḥ āḥ gdod nas ma bcos ka dag btsun mo'i mkha' lhan skyes ye shes brdal khyab snying rje'i mdangs zung 'jug rtsal las rig pa bam yig niX thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rtsal las basmranaX lha bskyed niḥ hrīḥ snang ba ma 'gags shes rab yum lnga'i klong srid pa dag chen dpa' bo yab kyi cha zung 'jug

yas 1 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul rol rtsed las rmad byung sprul pa sku yi zhing bkod shar0 de dbus rang byung lhub grub gzhal med khangaḥ rang rig ma bcos rgyal kun bskyed mdzad yumaX bde chen rgyal mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangasaḥ 'dzum pa'i nyams rgyas bcu drug lang tsho'i 'khyudaḥ 'dung dmar po dar dkar phu dung dngaḥ ljang sngon dar dpyangs rin chen mgul rgyan phrengaX phyag zhabs gdu bu rat+na'i dbu rgyan laḥ rgya g.yu mu tig gzi byur phra yis mdzes dar sna'i cod paṇa pad+ma'i gdengs ka spudaḥ g.yas pas bhasto bdud rtsi thugs gar brtenaḥ g.yon pas lcags phur dam sri'i snying la gziraḥ zhabs gnyis byed skyil bde sbyin rol thabs bzhugasaḥ sku la gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin rdzogasaX rigs kyibadag po pad 'byung a tsar+yaḥ gcer bu ḍā dril 'khrol zhing he ru ga'i cha lugs ma 'dres gsal bar 'od skur bzhugasaḥshar du bal 'bangs ka la sirnyi dkar lho ru mon mo bkra shis khe 'dren seraḥ nub tu bal mo shākya dhe wa dmaraX byang du lha lcam man+ta ra ba mthingaḥ kun kyang mdzes

'dzum lha mo'i cha lugs can dar dang rat+na rus pa'i rgyan gyis sprasaḥ gri gug thod 'dzin gar gyi thabs su bzhugasaḥ de rgyab tshangs 'dzin 'thar rol ma bzhi niḥ dkar ser dmar ljang gcer bu rus rgyan can lcags zhags sgrog dril pad+ma rnams par 'dzinaX stangs stabs gar rol bde stong nyams dgar spyodaḥ 'ja' 'od 'khrul klong snang stong gnyis med skuḥ brda don rtags rdzogs rang grol lha ru gsal gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru lasaḥ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rab 'phros pas rnga yab gling dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnasaX rang bzhin 'od gsal dag pa'i pho brang nasaX sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa rtsa spyan drangs gnyis med bde ba chen por bsreḥ spyan 'dren niḥ sa hrīḥ 'od gsal dhu ma tha la'i dkyil 'khor nasaḥ lhan skyes rje mo mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyalaḥ rang rig bla ma'i dgyes bskyed rnal 'byor maX ro mnyam rdo rje'i gar la spyan 'dren gshegs bzhugs gsol niḥ hrīḥ ma bcos lhun grub gshegs bzhugs yul las

yas / 'dasaḥ 'khrul 'khor snang ba chos skur sangs ba'i phyiraḥ kun khyab ye shes sku gsum mnyam nyid la du ma ro gcig 'du 'bral med par bzhugasaḥ phyaga'atshal ni na mo 'khor 'das dag mnyam lta ba gyad kyi lhaḥ ma bskyed ye rdzogs rig pa 'od gsal skuḥ 'dus ma byas pa ye mnyam dkyil 'khor la ngo mtshar rang ngo rig pasaphyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa 'bul ba ni hū tre+e gzung 'dzen mtshan mas ma gos 'od gsal ba'i phyi nang gsang mchod kun bzang rol ba'i rgyan nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lorayongs shar bas rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ lhan skyes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskangasaḥ rig stong 'od gsal mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'iḥ dngos grubabyin rlabs sgrub mchog rnams la stsolaX sa ma hā pañtsa pu dza ho bstod pa niḥhūṃ hrī mthong bas yid 'asgog mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang ngomasaX thos pas rnam grol tshangs dbyangs brdagla lenaḥ dran pas bde stong ye shes bskyed mdzad thugs 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje mo mchog la bstodaḥbacu drug bde ba'i mdangs ster pho nya moḥ gsal snang rig pa'i ting

'dzin dang 'grogs nas snod bcud brtan g.yo rtsa rlung thig le'i khamasaḥ kun bzang yum gyi bha gar dag gyur cigaḥ de nas 'dzab bzlas niḥhrīḥ rang snang rdo dze+ernal 'byo yiḥ thugs gar zla steng kun tu bzang mo yi srog gi go ru dga' 'khyil lte ba rtsa nyi zla kha sbyor dbus su hrīḥbam̐ḥlaḥ rtsa sngags bskor ba g.yon du 'khor ba lasaḥdapal yon 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i bcudaḥ ma lus bsdus te srog gi snying por bstimasaḥ snang grags rigs gsum bde chen ye shes ngangaḥ o pad+ma yo kai ni dzñā na bzlas sngags chu bo' gzhung ltar bzla don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur sa ma māḥsgrub 'dzab niḥ (ཿ rang sgog sngags kyiphreng ba 'khor de lasaḥ 'od 'phros 'khor 'das dpal yon bstims 'khrul ba ru brlog gdod ma'i sa la sbyoraḥ gang snang sku gsum mnyam nyid bde chen klongaḥ mi g.yo khyab brdal phyag rgya chen po'i ngangaḥ o dzñā na ḍaskos rā bye thal hūṃ āḥ sgrub sngags bar ma chad par bzla de ni dbang phyin dngos grub 'byu ཿ sa ma yā las sbyor 'dzab dmigs niḥ /hrīḥ rang 17ga sngags kyiphreng ba drag tu 'khoraḥ de las 'od 'phror

yas 1 pa bzhiX thogs med 'byung zhing bde stong gnyis med pa'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong ba dngaX gang snang ma bcos rang rig so ma'i bab bde stong klong yangs bha ga mnyam rol ngangaḥ ma gu h+ya dzña na bho dhi cit+ta ma hā su kha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūṃḥ las sngags 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs pa na ga 'dod phran las thogs med 'byungaḥ sa ma yuḥ de na dngo sa gzhi' rim pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas dngos grub gnad bskul ni kye hoḥ bde chen mnyam nyid chos dbyings btsun mo'i mkha' 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod wa ra hi'iḥ rnam 'phrul rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor ma yang yang bsnyen zhing sgom sgrub mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab 'dug pas mi gnas ye shes gsang ba gsum mdzod lasaḥ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa sgrub mchog rnal 'byer rnams la stsal du gsol rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya sirnyi oṃ wāk+ka sirnyi āX tsit+ta sidhi (ཿ sarba sirnyi hrī brgya rtsa brjod la mchad cing bstod bro bshags nyu bskrad pa ra bya byin dbab sman mchad mnyen bskang byed de nas gnad bskul snyan dbab ni yul nam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba rnams dgyes chags kyis rol rtsed g.yos

pa lasaḥbyang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar dmigs laḥhrīḥbade gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku yi dbang dang dngos grub stsolaX dam chos rgyud sde kun 'dus pa'iḥ gsung gi dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥmanyam brdal yi shes gting klong nasaḥthugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub stsolaXyon tan kun 'dus gsang mdzod las ༷dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ'agro khams thabs kyib 'dul nus pa'iX zad med phrin las dngos grub stsolaX kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ a shā hrī dga' ston shas brjod rgya chen bya des ni dbang byin dngos grub thob sa ma yu de ni rjes kyi rim pa'oḥrgya rgya rgya grub dbang 'ja' lu rdo rje yisaḥsnying tig zab bcud 'dus pa'i skor 'o yug bkra shis mig dgu la rgyas btab rin chen sa yi gter ngan lam rgyal mchog sprul pa yis brag dkar seng chung bya ba'i bcud dus tshag sa mo yos la son snga zog lcags 'brug ral brgya' khur man ngag dug lce 'dzin la bkrol rgyab chos chu yi cang shes la nges par bkrol dgos dam tshag yin ces pa ḍazhi gtam bgo ba zabs su bkod ste ma nam mkha'i dbang phyug gis chosabadag thub bstan dbang po laḥphan phyir shog skyar bkod pa'o//dge'o legs so masko lamaḥ

chas /ཿ dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ mkha' 'gra'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu'i bskang tshogs dngos grub sprin 'khrigs bzhugs rberngoḥ 42 1 na mo gu ru parnya ka ra ye pho zla 141 rgyalab kun gyi phrin las dpa la pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshalaḥ las ldan sgrub la snya rus can de ya bgo skal zab lam bstanaḥ sa ma shāḥm dang mkha' 'gro mnyes bskang phyir ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lor brtson bza' bca' b.lo ba'i rigs rnams bsags sbyangs spel byin brlabs bya ba ni ho bde ba chen po' snod mchog ka pā laraḥ blang dor bral ba'i bral ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi sogasaX mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog bsreg gtor bkru ngo bo gnyis med mnyam pa'i sprin chen spol tshogs zhing sbyan 'dren niḥ / hrī dhu ma tha la mo rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yulaḥ bde stong nyams dgar spyod pa'i pho brang nasaX 'bum phrag ḍak+ki'i spyi rje wā ra ti'iḥ rnam 'phrul gangs ldongs yongs kyi skyabs gcig ma grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs0 tshogs phud ni 'bul ba niḥ ho blang dor mtshan grol gnyis med mnyam mchod 'diḥ rnal 'byer

dbang mo nyer bzhi 'brel ba yi 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍak+ki ma tshogs laḥ gus pas 'bul lo dgyes bzhes dngos grub stsolaX bar bshags ni lha phyogasarisabral ba kun tu bzang mo'i klong rtag chad mu bzhir bzung ba'i gnyis 'dzin nongasaḥ bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med dgongs pas gziraḥ 'khor 'das grol 'khrul rig pa dhu tir ā bsgral ba niḥ hūṃ trīḥ snying rje lcags kyusalog gzul mchor med zungs lta ba'i mtshon chen shes rab rdon pos bsgralaX thal 'byin phur pas chos can chos nyid dang 'khrul 'khor mnyam klong gzhig mdzod mā ra yāḥ bstab pa niḥ/ hrīḥ ye nasam bcosathig le nyag gcig zhalaX 'khor 'das mnyam par rol ba'i e slong duḥ log 'khrul bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched bstabs mi ldog bde ba chen por 'ub chub rolaḥ lhag ma ni lo rdo rje'i shugs can mkha' la thogs med rgyuX cir yang ma nges thabs phrin bsam mi khyabaX thabs chen yab la stong pa'i rgyas 'debs ba'iḥ dbang phyug ma sring 'bar ma king lang rnamasaX brngan mchod pham phab dpal gyi bka' lung bzhinaḥ bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'bras bu

yas 1 mchis par mdzod0 bskul ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings rol pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas ye shes las grub 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro rnamasaḥ thabs chen gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs laX snod bcud 'byung ba'i rgud pa mtha' dag solaḥ rnal 'byor tshe dpal nyams rtogs yo tan bskyedaḥ 'khor 'das rang grol rig pa'i klong dbang bsdusaḥ gnyis snang 'dzag med dbu ma'i stobs su bstims mi nub 'od gsal bde stong rab 'bar zhingaḥ 'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub pa'i brin las mdzod chad tho na hū hrīḥ sngon tshe spyi dpal he ru ka nyid kyisaḥ snying pa'i thig le zab bcud 'dus pa'i skoraX lag na rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug laḥ gtad pa'i dam tshig las kyi mkha' 'gror son dus kyi 'bras bzang dri med bshes gnyesagyisaX 'gyur med rdo rje bkod pa'i dpal bcud drangasaX 'chims kyi phug dang zhwa yi lha khang dngaḥ 'o yug snye mo'i ldongs dang rdza'i ra ba brag dkar seng chung bum mkhar stag sgo sogasaḥ zab bcud skor rnams sbas gsang rgya bsdams tsheḥ gnyer dam blang ba'i gtsang btsan dmar nag dngaḥ 'o yug gangs dkar lha

mo she ne dang rdo rje kong btsum de mo bod khams skyongasaX rang rang bka' 'khor sprul ba g.yog dang bcasaX zhal bzhes bzhin du chad tho 'di bzhes la lte sgom nam mkha'i dbang phyug he ru gsaḥ 'o yug brag dkar snying po grol thig le'i sbas rgya klong bkrol sred len dben brda rnyed 'khrul ba gzhir sangs rig stongs sor bzhag gnadaḥ dang ma 'od sku 'grub pa'i thugs dam mthilaḥ ma g.yel myur du rtsol zhig dregs pa'i tshogasaḥ rdo rje'i dam las ma 'da' sa ma yā bstan ma niḥ trīḥ srid pa'i rten 'brel lug 'byung bkod pa laḥ legs nyes khrims ston stong par rgyas 'debs pa'i ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis g.yog dang bcasaḥ bde stong ro mnyam gtor mas brngan bzhes laḥ 'khor ba'i bag chags chos nyid dgongs klong spyoraḥ srid pa'i drwa gtor ldog med sku gsum ngangaḥ rta bro niḥs rang bzhin mnyam nyid yum byi bha ga rtsa thabs chen rig pa'i rdo rje bsre sbyor mthusaḥ gnyis snang mtshan ma'i rā tra kun bcing nasaḥ rigs lnga ye shes lnga klong 'byur med rgyaḥ gags sbyang bzod gsol niḥhoḥ rtag chad mtha' ru lhung ba'i lta ba dngaḥ yid dpyod

yas 1ཿ sems kyi shun 'dres sgom pa'i nongs gtsang sme re rtogs tho co'i spyod pa sogasaḥ mtha' grol sang yangs rdzogs pa chen por bshags bsngo ba ni nyo snang srid tham cad dag pa mkha' spyod zhingaX ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsangaḥ sna tshogs sprul pa sku yi 'khor lor kunaX gnyis med kun tu bzang mor byang chub shog rtag ca mtha' bsal niḥ lto chu las chu bur rdol ba'i rten 'brel bzhinaḥ rang rig mdangs las 'phrul ba'i dkyil 'khor lhaX mtha' grol slong yangs ye shes dbyings su rluḥ rjes thob sgyu ma'i lhar ldang spyod lam byaḥ shis brjod na na so rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig rnal 'byor maḥ bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas mtsho rgyal ngomasaḥ rigs mchog pad+ma'i lcam gcig sgrub sde mosaḥ thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i shis pa stsolaḥ bsngo ba smon lam mtha' rgyas gdab shis pa bge da cing dga' ston bya tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje'ibaka'aḥ sa ma yu ngan lam rgyalamachog sprul pa yas dus tshigs sa mo yos kya lor sred len bral ba'i brda mdzod phyesaḥste btsun nam mkha' dbang phyug gis rin chen shog skyar bkod pa yis thub bstan dbang po mnyes bskang
nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug nus shogaḥlas ldan skal bzang bcu gsum sogs dngasama' 'od sku 'grub par shog dge'o legasaso masgo lo/

ya/sa / dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyi:zab tig yang snying 'dus pa las phyi dbang dag byed kyi chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ 1gus 1 na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra ye za phyo/no/tsa/ze'i rgyal ba kun dngosapadha 'byung snying dbus dang brgya'i ze'u 'byur rol skal ldan sgrub la snying rus can tshe gcig 'od lus bsgrub 'dod pa saḥ'ajug sgo dbang nas byed pa gces man ngag mdo rtsa gcig tu drilaḥs ma yu de pang rin chen bum pa nyad phyi dor chag gdab dra bzang byug a phra ta dang snying khu sbyar bla med nyer lnga bcud ldan bsreḥl grangs gzung dang bcud chen bskyil mgul chings gzungs thag kha rgyan gdab da la' dbus bzhugs nyer spyod bkrams bdag mdun gnyi med lnga ru sgrub tshogs bsags rig pa'i me tog phul slob ma gral bsdu khrus bgegs bsgrad bsrung 'khor sgom la bden don lad mkha phul la gsolagadab na kya tshogs kyi dbang phyug he ru ga rdo rje rgyal po bde ba'i mchogaXkun nas brtse ba chen po'i dgongs smin byed dbang gi dngos grub stsolaḥlan gsum zhu lan gnang niḥhoḥdakyil 'khor gcig tu 'tshogs pa rnams:brgal spyod dka' ba'i dam tshig rimaḥbasrung na dngos grub dam pa sbyinaḥtshe 'dir byang chub

yas 1 mnyam par sbyor sku ni mi g.yo mgon po yi snang tshad lha sku'i phyag rgyar spyodaḥ bde chen rdo rje'i dam bsre'oḥ badz+ra rak+ta tsheḥ bde gshegs kun dang mnyam par spyoraX gsung ni brjod bral 'gags med klong grags pa sngags kyi rang sgrar spyodaX rang byung chos kyi dam bsre'oḥ badz+ra rak+ta ā0 rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor thugs ni mkhyen gzigs 'khrul yang ngangaḥ sems 'gyu rang rig 'dus ma byasaX zang thal ye shes dam bsre'iḥ badz+ra rak+ta /༷ gsang ba las kyi dkyil 'khor du dam tshig sgog gis bsdus pa yi 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams mchog tu mi 'gyur gral bsre'oX a mṛ ta badz+ra rak+ta i dhan hri hūṃX mthong dang dran dang nyan byed kyi gsang ba las kyi brda don bstan bdud rtsi ngoms bzhin myang bar byos badz+ra rak+ta si 〉༷ zhes sbyanarngos na ra gaṇaḥ zhes spyod do mig dar bkab la me tog sbyin slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbab brten par bzhugs gsol rab tu gnas sgrib dar dbye zhing me tog dor mthong ba bstan la gsang mtshan gdags de nas thun mong rig pa'i dbang bskur bar bya ba 'di lta steḥ hūṃ hrīḥ zhe sdang me khams rab gsod cingaX ma rig gnyis snang dri

las 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ nang dbang 'byung ba snyoms pa'i chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥg(1/ — na mo gu ru parlu ka ra ye lhunazu che khu rig kun pongasa'ad pad+ma 'byung mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo bzhugs las dang skal ba 'dzom pa la nang dbang 'byung ba'i chu bo bstanaḥ sa ma wāḥ de yang dum gcig bharnya phu dkar dmar byang sems ba da chen poḥ dza gad bzang po dang sbyar ba ཿ myong grol pañtsa a mṛ bsre da la'i dbus bkod nyer spyod bkrams byin brlabs dbang bskur gzi byin bskyed slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis bkru tho 'tshams bgegs gsal srung gur phub maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab niḥ e maḥ gsang sngags mchog gi don ston paḥ rdo rje sgob dpon dgongs su gsolaḥ bde chen ye shes mchog gi dbangaX bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes lan gsum zhu de nas bla ma'i lan gnang ba e maḥ yang dag don la mos gus thob gsod nams mchog gi mthu rdzogs pa khyod la gsang chen dbang dgos na snang srid bla mar blta nus samaḥ sgra grags gsung su khyer nus samaḥ dran rtog ye shes mthong ngam bu gnad dang ldan na gsang dbang sbyinaX

mas 1 la sogs grangs ldan yul bar bya de nas 'dod don gsol ba niḥ ho rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs khyed rnams la bdud rtsi bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba la brten nas bdag dang sems can thams can kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag pa dngaḥ tshe gsod dpal 'byer nyams rtogs yo tan thams can 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang khams gsum srid gsum lha srin dregs pa thams cad dbang du 'du ba dngaḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i sgo nas tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cigaX skabs su kun la gdags par bya de na bstod pa bya ba na lasabyang rang rang bzhung ltar bya tshogasabaskang mchod gtor rgya cher 'bul de na gtang rag 'bul ba na ma badz+ra rda bu la ye swā hāḥ zhes so rtsi 'bul ma badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ye swā hāX zhes gos zung 'bulaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ dngos 'byor yid las skyes pa yiḥ phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin0 rmad byung rig ma'i 'phrul rtsed bcasaX rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ pusgo dhub pes lo ke gharnye ne+e wi du shasta rū pa shabha gharnye ra sa sparnye dharmā ma hā pañtsa a dṛ

ཿde 1 dbyings su rluḥ dam tshig pa bdag nyid rtsa ba'i thugs gar bsdu'oḥ de nas me lha'i gto rag ni re asne tsalaram̐ḥche lha sngar bzhe dugasalal yin badz+ra haṃ bu la ye swāhā: zhes so rtsi 'bul yin badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ye swā shā zhes gos zung 'bul sngar bzhin mchod la rdzas rnams na sngagasatshan gsum gesa'abul ba'oḥ gshegs skyems gtor mar 'bul ba niḥ.a ka sdo mi byinargyas brlabs ཿ hrī dze+en chen mjes pa'i sgod nang duḥ 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor chen bshamasaḥ 'dod don rdzogs pa'i gtang rag tu drang sgong me lhar 'bul gyis bzhes oṃ.asne ye e rda ba lirnyakhā hiX nyer gcig bsdo da la dgyes pa bskangs bstod pa bzod gsol sngar ltar bya de nas bsdu rim bya ba niḥ.a drang sreng chen pe sku drin canaḥ da ni rang rang gnas su gshegs gtan du gshegasapa mi 'tshal bsaX slar yang dus su 'dod don stsol badz+ra rluḥmi lha rang bajen pa rang rang gi gnas su gshegs dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur de nas shis brjod bya ba na hu hrīḥ phan bde 'byung bami gnas gcig puḥ bstan pa rgyas shing der 'dzin 'phelaḥ sku tshe ring zhing bshad sgrub dar mdzad phrin mtha' rgyas bkra shis shogaḥ bsngo smon shis brjod rgya

cher bya des ni rab 'byamasaphrin las 'grub sa ma māḥmimarig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje yis man ngag zab mdzod grol zig skor rtsesgom chosakyirdo rjer son bshad sgrub bstan pa mtha' rgyasaphyir rin chen shog skyar sprengapa'oḥs ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyi zhes pa 'di'ang chosabadag thub bstan dbang po dgyesaphyir kho bo snyesgomachosakyirdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las la bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ger pa ni lung zinapo kairtibasabagyis pa dge legasa'aphel/sarba ma lam/

yas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa las rig 'dzin gsang lam gyi man ngag 'khor lo bzhi pa a haṃ bde ba'i brtul zhugs bzhugs soḥ yas 1 na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra yeḥ tshanasgothos sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gzigs rje btsun bla ma la phyag 'tshalaX skal ba bzang po'i skyes bu yisaḥ bsgrod pa gcig myur gsang lam bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ gsang mdzod bla ma'i da la rtsa dbang gis smin pa'i rnal 'byer paX rgyu 'grul dben par sgrub tshugs 'dzin rlung chas bde stong gos bzang bgoX 'bru mar bzang drug sbyar ba yisaḥ ril bu zas su brten par byaX lus gnad bdun dang ldan pa yis srog shing gsum la 'khor lo bzhiX khrag 'thung rig 'dzin zhi ba'i dalaḥ ḍāk+ki sprin gtibs yangs rdzongs laḥ rnal 'byor lam gyi rlung gi thabasaḥ sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pa yisaḥ mi rtog spyod pa ro yi lamaX ye shes rkyang 'char sgo ru brgyung0 tho gyis drangs la āḥltar dbabaḥ hūṃ ni 'gyur med bde bas rgyasaḥ tshangs stong 'bar ba shes rab chaX bskul nas dam tshig phyag rgya steḥ yan lag bzhi

yas 1ཿ mdangs rgyas lus yangs rdzu 'phrul thobaḥ 'du ba'i nad grol rgyu bas 'tsho shig sgo rgud gnyer mi 'byung zhingaX tshe ni nyi zla dang mnyam zhing yon tan ri rgyal lhun po 'draḥ lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo bde ba'i mdzod la 'dud cing brtse: dregs pa 'i dbang phyug chen po zhes rdul bral dngas ba'i 'khor lo 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaX masabartan shes rab gsang ba'i 'khor lo rgyab brten gyi spyi chings zab mo/ snyiḥ 'bar ba dbang gi sku mchog niḥ gnyis snang za ba'i gtum mor sbyor ༷ bde ba kun gyi 'gros rim canaX thig le'i dbyed ni ya mtshan 'charaḥ gnyis gnyis rgya mdud grol ba las spang rtogs yon tan cha re 'byungaḥ sgog pa dbu gu klong nas grolaḥ pad+ma'i gting mdzod rdol ba lasaX 'bru'i spyi chings mngon du brnyesaḥ rig 'dzin rgyal po e ma hoḥ sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgya: bde stong dpa' bo'i rtogs brjod zab mosnyiḥ lcags dkar mig tsho dbang mo la lung gos dus tshig gnyas par bshad thub bstan chosakyi dab po ni rdo rje'i rigs 'chang dam pa ste tshe bsri sa dar thag skyes bzang po dge bsnyen go btsun 'dzum pa 'i rdzas rtags da rten 'brel phun tshogs phyar ste sgom chos kya rdo rje
yis 'o yug rdza yi ra ba'i mdzod sred len bral ba'i brda gsang las tsa ri tra nas spel ba'oḥ sarba make laḥ

mas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snyeng 'dus pa lasaḥ rig 'jin brgyud ba'i gsang mdzod man ngag gi rgyab yig nor bu'i dpal khang bzhugs soḥ yas 1 na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra yeX ras/tsa/ rigs dang dkyil nasar 'dus pa'i gter rje btsun bla ma la phyag 'tshalaḥ skal ldan bsgrod pa gcig pu'i lamaḥ man ngag brgyud pa'i gsang mdzod bstanaḥ sa ma yāX zab pa kun gyi phul byin pas ye shes kun byi gsang ba mthong rim gyi lam la mi ltos pas cig char nye ba'i lam zhes bsngagasaḥ zab dang rgya che kun las 'phagasaXrdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor zhesaX tshe lus gcig gis rig 'dzin gyi gral khod yang dag grub pa'i rtser brnyes dang rgol ba smod mi rungaX rnal 'byer rnal 'byor ma dang mnye ye shes bcu drug phan tshun bsreḥ bo la gasgo 'dres pa las bde dang stong pa'i 'od gsal 'drenaX kun khyab rtogs pa klong nas 'charaḥ gzod ma'i gshis lugs gcer byung mjalaḥ 'khrul ba'i gnyis ka dbur mar chubaḥ zag med ye shes rtsal sgo 'baraḥ 'di ni blo gros can la dbangaX glen

pa sra ga ra la ring de phyir yon tan ldan pas 'chongaḥ sa ma yāḥ dga' bzhis drangs ba'i 'od gsal deḥ stong pa nyid du la bzla ba'i ཿ man ngag 'khor lo bzhi pa dngaX 'gros dgus gcun pa'i thabs zab mo ༷ brtul zhugs gar gyi bog 'don dngaX zab pa'i man ngag spyi chings dang mdo rtsa lkog yig gab pa'i don dam tshig zab gnad rim pa steḥyan lag brgyad kyi man ngag bstanaḥ dug lce 'dzin ma'i 'khor lo laḥ dus gnad rim pa lung gis bstan rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje yi dgongs pa mi 'gyur brda yi mdzodaX 'o yug rdza yi ra ba nas gtsang btsan gangs dkar she je yis brda thabs rten 'brel mthus bskul nas lce sgom nam mkha'i rnal 'byer gyis lcags 'brug ral brgya'i 'dab mar son ༷ ḍāk+kis bsngags pa'i dus tshigs suḥ rtsa gsum grub skor zab rgya bkrol de bzhin gnyis pa'i zab gnad la0 man ngag phyi nang gsang ba'i skoraX kha bskang rgyas 'debs bcas te bkodaX sa ma yāX las dang smon lam rten 'brel gyiX mthu las byung ba'i skyes bu niḥ rigs lnga'i rtags 'dzin rnal 'byor lngaX dpa' bo 'gro

ཿsa 1 'dul rdo rje dngaX rab gsal bkra shis rgya mtsho dpalaḥ lha rje mkhas btsun shī la dngaX mos ldan dge bzang bya ba dang spyod zhib gzhan phan rgya mtsho ste phrin las mtha' rgyas rig 'dzin lngaX dus su gegs med phun sum tshogasaḥ 'gro don bsam yas nyi ltar gsalaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ lce sgom chos kyi rdo rje yis ༷ rinachen shog skyar bkod pa'i dgesaḥthub bstan dbang po dgyes gyur nasaḥ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa dngaḥ 'od lus dri med grub pa yiḥ bstan 'dzin dar zhing rgyas gyur cig sarba maṅga le/

yas 1 dam chos grol b.lithig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snyeng 'dus pa lasaX rig 'jin gsang lam gyi gar chen 'gros dgu'i gcun pa'i thabs zab rdo rje'i brtul zhugs zhes bya ba bzhugs soX yas 1 na mo gu ru padha ka ra yeḥ rjoX rjo/ rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung dad brgya'i ze'u 'brur rtag tu rol skal bzang bde spyod rnal 'byor bsaX bsgrod pa gcig myur zab lam bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥgasang chen dbang bzhi 'byung ba'i gnasaX rdo rje bla ma la brten nas gsol gdab dbang len thugs yid bsreḥ de bzhin nyid la mnyam par bzhagaX gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung bkod pa byang chub sems mchog nyidaḥ dkon mchog rgya mtshor shes pa yis skyabs kyi dngas ma nyid du 'changaḥ dmus long ma gyur 'gro ba rnams rtag tu ngan 'gro'i rba klong las skems sar drangs phyir 'gro drug gi sa bon rnams ni skems par bya'oX sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya sdon 'gro sems kyirtsal sbyangasalhoḥ spyor ba bzhidang ldan pa yisaḥ rlung gnad mnyam bzhag rjes thob zungasaḥ rtag tu dam tshig nyid du 'dzin ma dag las kyi rlung
