yas 1 nyid don ngo bo nyid dang 'gyur ba medaḥ tshogs chen mthus drangs spang rtogs kyiḥ yon tan ma lus lhug pa mthongaḥ sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgyaX dngos gzhi 'gros gsum gyi brtul zhugs3) snang bamigados mtshan grol ba las stug po bkod par snang mched grolaḥ dag chen ye shes 'khor lo rtsa gnyis 'thung spri las 'phags pa'i khrir bde stong 'od gsal zhal sbyor kharaḥ rdul sprin zhen 'dzin dag pa'i skuX don rtags brda gsum tshang ba yiḥ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'dasaX 'khor lo lnga brtsegs dbus ma laX srog thur oṃ las zer chen gyisaḥ gti mug 'khrul ba'i gnas yul stongaḥ byang chub mnyam pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyisaḥ ma dag 'khrun 'chil g.yo ba bshigasaḥ gtegs 'bebs gsum gyi gar la brtenaḥ kun rmongs rgyu 'bras snang ba stong chos kyi dbyings su ngal bso byaḥyang rtsig mngon par dga' ba niḥ dag grol ye shes gsal snang du gdos lngas btegs ba'i khri rkang laḥ a dang ma yig paṃ gsum khar gzung ba yul bcas dag pa'i sku brda don rtags kyi mtshon dpe rdzogasaX 'od lus dri med rdo rje sems

mi bskyod ye shes sgog shing laḥ 'khor lo lnga'i dbus dwangs ma yi srog thur (ཿgi 'od zer gyis zhe sdang las skyes gnas yul stong rgyas 'debs rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor gyisaḥro ma rkyang ma kun 'dar maḥ tshangs 'bar chos bskyed rdul 'khor loḥ sku gsum ye shes lnga dang bsreḥ seng chen 'byug 'bebs gsum la brten 'khrugs shing sdang ba'i 'khrul 'khor stong dag gsal me longs ngang la yan yang cig dpal dang ldan pa niḥ rdul bral shin tu rnam par dgaḥ hi yas btegs pa'i rkang pa bzhiraX chu las skyes dang rta lnga bdun nyams zhen tshor ba rang grol sku gsal dag stong pa'i rab mtshon dpalaḥ 'dod 'byung rin chen dpal ster niḥ btso bsrogs brdal ba'i gzi mdangs canaX ka ba gsum la yan lag lnga sgog la gnas pa'i swā yig las brdal khyab 'od ni mtha' yas pasaḥ nga rgyal las skyes gnas yul stongaḥ rat+na gsum pas mnyam rgyas 'debs hag gis dbyung la haṃ gis drangasaḥ phaṭa kyis gtor ba gsum ldan pas gyi ling 'dril 'bebs gsum la brten kheng zhing bde gsal 'khrul 'khor stong mnyam pa nyid du ngal

yas 1 bso byaḥ yang cig pad+ma brtsegs pa niḥ 'jig rten spros rtog bral ba yiḥ bde chen 'od snang bkod pa rtsa yangs pas btegs pa'i khri skang niḥ ka ma tha la tsan+ta'i zhal sur+ya sum sbyor dal dbus suḥ mtshan 'dzin 'du shes rang grol skuḥ dri med dag chen mnyam pa'i zhalaḥ'od snang mtha' yas dkyil 'khor niḥ pad+ma rā ga'i phung po la nyin byed 'bum 'khyud gzi mdangs 'bar 'khor lo gsum gnyis srog shing gcig gyen tu rgyu dang thur du sel bar na mkhas pas gnad btsal steng ༷ e las 'od zer sprin mtha' yasaX spros pas chags bsdus gnas yul stongaḥ mnyam sbyor phyag gis thal sgra bcas sku mnye 'bar ba'i gzi byin dbabaX shad brdab tshag dang blta stangs stabs rma bya'i 'gyur sdebs gsum dang bcasaX yi dwags 'khor ba dongs sprugs nasaḥ so sor rtog sang ngal bso byaX yang cig las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing gdos mtshan spros pa rnams par dag mkha' lding gyis btegs khri rkang kharaḥ pad nyi zla ba gsum sbyor kharaḥ las bsags 'du byed rang grol skuḥ mnyam sbyor tha ler gzigs pa'i zhal don

yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni in+t+ra lta bu'i ri bo laX bkrag brgyas 'byud 'dra'i gzi mdangs 'baraḥ 'khor lo lnga yi srog shing gi phyed skyil ta las ze 'bru laḥ hāḥ lasa'od zer bsam yas 'phrosaḥ phrag dog las skyes gnas yul stongaḥ skyabs sbyin haṃ gis 'dren stangs bcasaḥ mgo bo g.yas g.yon mtha' skor dang nyi zlar mkhar bzhugasarol mtsho bcal g.yo nas brten pa res mos bya 'phur 'bebs gsum gyi gar dang bcas 'thab cing rtsod pa'i 'khrul 'khor stongaX dag grol ngang la mnyam par bzhagaX hasgra drag po gsum brjod nas phyi nang 'byung rlul stong par bshigs rang bab gshis gyi ngo bo skyongs rtsa 'gros lus kyi gnad las 'bebasaḥ rlung 'gros rtsa yi gnad lasa'abyungaḥ me 'gros rlung gi shugs las bskyedaḥ thig le me yi zer gyi dbabaḥ dga' bzhi 'bar bskyed rlabs kyis drangasaḥ stong pa de yi rjes su mngonaḥ 'od gsal gnyis kyi'adzum las 'khrungaḥ rim gyis spang rtogs mtha' ru phyinaḥ sa lam mthar phyin sku mngon gyuraḥ bde ba'i lam myur e ma hoḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya rdul sprugs 'dza sa lnga'i rim pa

mas 1 snyiḥ bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor masaX aḥdzhaḥbazhu btul 'khor lo lnga'i 'bar ba 'dzag bsre mnyam sbyor skyongasaX stobs kyi nor bu he ru bcing rdo rje'i snying po yi ge gzhugasaḥ yas mas thabs shes rim pa yisaḥ bcu drug phyed phyed bde ba'i 'grosaḥ kun la khyab pas rtsis las 'dasaḥ dbab pa chu bo dal 'bebs yinaḥ bskyil ba yul la rdzing bu 'drenaḥ bkram pa chab la 'o ma bsreḥ dgram pa nam mkha'i bā la bzlogaX rjes thob rig stong ngang la bltaḥ slar yang g.yas su gom stabs bsgyur pad+ma gar gyi phyag rgya yisaX a glu nyer gcig brjod par bya de bzhin g.yon du stangs stabs bsgyuraḥ ha hūṃ haṃ gis 'dren tshul bcasaḥ phaṭa gsum ngar gyis 'khrul ba bcar: slar yang rgyab tu lta zur gyi 'phen bskor gdengs ba gsum bsres nas a ri li pha trīng sgra niḥ dbugs kyi rta la lan gsum bskyonaḥ yang cig mdun tu zhal kyu nas sa ga seng 'gying gsum 'dzom pas dregs pa thams cad dam la 'dogs pho rgyud dpa' bo las la bskul mo rgyud ḍāk+ki bran tu bkolaḥ rig 'dzin tshogs la snyan gsan 'bebs lta ba'i nga

ro a zhes sgrogs stong nyid dgongs pas 'dzin phur gtoraḥ sgom pa'i nga ro hūṃ zhes gyeraX ched 'dzin blo yi shun pa bkrol spyod pa'i nga ro phaṭa ces brtegaḥ rtsis gdab 'chosam thams cad gshigs 'bebs dgu brdab pa'i brtul zhugs kyis chos kun mtshan ma zad par byedaḥ sgo gsum spros pa bral bar bzhag bcing grol med pa'i gnasalugs skyongs rtogs pa nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgya thabs chen shes rab kyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i 'gros chen gcig pu sde dgu pasnyiḥ g.yo bskogang dkar she ne yas brda dang thabs chen rtags kyi bkrol rag 'dzan 'ja' lu rdo rje yis dgongs pa' klong rgya zab mo ni lcags 'brug ral brgya'i ze'u 'brur son sred len bral kyang don gyi brda ḍak+ki'i spyon gcig khol mas brtsal rtse sgom nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis nor bu skor gsum zab rgya niḥ dang po' dusatshig gnas su bkrol man ngag bde stong sgom rim rnams gnyis pa dug lce 'dzin ma'i 'dab dbang chen sprel gyi zla ba la rdo rje'i rag 'chang rnala'abyor gyis tshe bsreng dar gyi 'dun ma dang nor mchog bkra shis snag bzang po dam 'brel lug rgyud thag pa dang bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'grug zhes bskul rten 'brel don dang ldan pa'i phyir rin chen shog skyar bkod pa yi
sa shā 1 dge bas dam ldan pho mo rnams brtul sas grub pa'i sku brtes nas rig 'dzin gral du 'khod gyur cigaḥsarba masgo lo/

chas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig le3niḥ zab tig yangs snying 'dus pa lasaḥ rig 'jin gsang lam gyi brtul zhugs gar bsgyur bog 'don zab mo bzhugs soḥ yas 1 na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra yeḥ 1za rigs dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i dpalaX rdo rje'i bla ma la phyag 'tshalaḥ bsod nams las smon 'phro 'dzom pa'iX dbang skal bsgrod lam gcig pu bstanaḥ sa ma yuX gnasapa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlungaḥ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi dal0 bde dang stong pas gtams pa laḥ ye shes 'gros kyi gnad la brtson rlung log rtsa 'chig thig le sdudaḥ de yi gegs bsal zab pa'i gnadaḥ lusangag sems kyis rgyu shan dbye de la rdo rje'i gar zhes brjodaX gnad gcin 'gyengabargyang lta stangs gziraḥ ri bo g.yo med zur bzhi bstanaX steng 'og kha sbyor zung 'jug rlungaḥ thad gar bskyil ba ye shes kyiḥ sbyor ba chen po zhes su grags nyi zla nam mkha'i mthong su bkra rngad rgo gnyis nas sang sang bkrolaḥ rol mtsho rin chen brag la bcalaḥ rdo rje 'byugs ni thabs la sbraraḥ tshe mda' 'byur med drangs por bsgongasaḥ bum pa

bzang po lcags kyu bzhinaḥ brten byed 'khor lo rdo rje bca' yon tan bdun dang ldan pa yis spyor ba bzhi tshang rlung gnad kyis 'bar ba yan lag lnga ldan bskul bde ba nam mkha'i ba bzhos nas byang chub sems kyis spel khyab byed nyon mongs tshogs ni 'joms byas teḥ ye shes snang ba rgyas par mthongaḥ tshogs nas mi slob mthar phyin b.raḥyon tan yar ldan tshul du 'khrungaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya bde stong snyom pa'i dkyil 'khor dga' ba bzhi 'gros kyi spyi bshadasnyiXsnang ba rig 'dzin zhing du sbyangasaḥ grags pa ru lu ha he sgrogs dran bsam chos nyid don la gtugs lus ni bskor chen brtul zhugs kyisaḥ gcos 'bebs gsum dang ldan pa niḥ / chen ka ra'i rnal 'byor yin snang ba 'jigs byed tshal du sbyangs brjod med haṃḥsgra thang drug gyer sems ni 'od gsal don la gtadaḥ lus kyis 'gying 'phen gdab 'dril byaḥ bsgrad chen 'bebs gsum brdab pa ni 'jam dpal bshesaganyen rnal 'byor yinaḥ snang ba dga' ba tshal du bkodaḥ a glu 'brug gi mgrin glu khyeraX mi g.yo rig gdangs ngang brkyangs nas lus ni 'degs

yas 1 'khril gtegs spar bkanaX rgur 'bebs gsum dang ldan pa ni klu sgrub snyeng po'i rnal 'byor yin snang ba ha ha sgrogs su bkodaḥ grags pa hūṃ gi dbyangasasnyan gyeraḥ shes pa dga' stong ngo bor blta lus ni rdul sprugs 'khrul 'khor bca'aḥ rdo rje thog 'bebs gsum rgyas gdabaḥpra bha hasti'i rnal 'byor yin snang ba 'od dedabyings la mjalaḥ bsdu gtor yi ge ngag nas bgyedaḥ bzo med lhug par mnyam bzhag skyongs lus ni 'bar gcus 'khrul 'khor bca' bsgrad chung 'bebs gsum brdabapa niX dha na so kṛ'i rnal 'byor yin snang ba sprul ba sku ru bkodaḥ ha hūṃ nyaḥgis bzlas par bslabaḥ ma bcos 'od gsal thad gar skyongasaḥ lus ni gar 'khyug thabs chenabasgyur dgye rgu bar 'bebs gsum brdab nas ༷ de bzhin nyid skyongs phaṭa sgra brjod be+e ma mi tra'i rnal 'byor yinaḥ snang ba 'od du sbyangs ba dngaX bzlas pa 'bru gsum rdo rjebaskyaraḥ bzo med gnyug ma'i ngo bo skyongasaḥ lus ni gtor bsgyur sdeg dang bcas rgur chung 'bebs gsum brdab pa niḥras gu rgya'i rnal 'byor yinaḥ sna tshogs snang ba khro rdul

dkrigasaX brjod pa ru lu he ya sgrogs:shes nyams de gzhin nyid du klod lus ni tshangs dmigs bsnol brdab dpag 'bebs chen 'byugs bcas gsum brdab po shirnye ghar+bha'i rnal 'byor yin lus kyi shin sbyangs 'khrul 'khor ste rtsa 'byun 'khrug dkrugs sdum ral bzlogaḥ rlung log ngar thung had 'thibs zhi thig le g.yo 'gul 'khyog ldal selaX de phyir bog 'don zab mo yinaX sa ma yā rgya rgya rgyaḥrdo rje gar gyi 'gros chen brtul zhugs gsang ba'i bog 'donasnyiḥ chosanyid zhi ba rdo rje'i khrabaḥ 'dren stangs lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yisaḥ dzaḥzhes dregs pa dbang du sdudaḥ tshad med snying rje'i ngang la yan nyams rtogs dpal rgyas rat+na'i khrab 'ching thabs zhags pa'i phyag rgya yisaḥ (ཿzhes sde brgyad dam la 'dogasaḥ tshad med byams pa'i ngang la gnasaḥ rlung sems dbang sdud pad+ma'i khrab sdom pa sgrog gi phyag rgya yis bam:zhes ma rung las la 'khrun tshad med dga' ba'i ngang la brdalaḥ las rnams mthar phyin rgya gram khrab: myos pa dril bu'i phyag rgya yisaḥ hoḥzhes gdug pa ar la gtadaḥ tshad med btang snyoms ngang la bzhag

yas /ཿ gtegs bsgrad bsdu phaṭa 'phar drug bcasaḥ dgu 'bebs rjes su ha he ho rdul bshigs sgo gsum kha yan skyongasaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ rgyas 'debs phrin las kyi mtha' brgyan zab mo(1ཿ gu hraḥ 'ja' lusardo rje'i dgongs pa'i mthil lce sgomachosakyi rdo rje yis skal ldan thub bstan dbang po la bsod nams bre kha bkang ba'i lan rin chen shog skyar bkod nas phul bka' 'di gtsang btsan mched kyis srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sarba maṅga lam̐/

yas / dam chos grol ba'i thig lephyogaḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaḥ rig 'dzin gsang lam gyi zab pa'i lan ngag spyi chings zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥyas / na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye: 18sgo sa rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshalaḥ las smon dam gtsang pho mo yisaX bgo skal zab pa'i man ngag bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ me dang nyi ma'i drod mi rtsolaḥ tsi ḍa ka dang bcud med kyiḥ zas la 'dzems shing snum ldan 'chang ri dwags g.yung dgas gcan gzan gyi lpags pa sha can gos mi byaḥ phrug dang snam ther srab mo bgoḥ rlung chas e rag sgom thag dang 'bol stan mdzes 'jam khod snyoms bsgrigasaX phyi nang rgyu 'grul dam rgyas bcadaḥ dngos grub nye byir shin tu gsangaḥ bde ba 'bar phyir bdud rtsi bzhu me drod 'char slad gtum me sbaraḥ nyams rtogs 'phel phyir rlung gnang brkyangs re dogs ro nyoms dgongs pa gnadaX des ni bde stong ye shes 'charaḥ brtul zhugs grub pa'i rtags mtshan brnyesaḥ don gnyis lhun grub the tshom med0 sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya zab pa'i man

ngag spang blang gi gnad bstan pa'i chings3giḥ mal nas sad pa thag pa dra rlung gi dug dbyung nan du bya de nas sbyor ba bzhi ldan pa'i mnyam bzhag rlung la nan cher brtson rjes thob bar rlung bum pa can dran dang ye shes bskyed rdzogs sogs kun gyi rten gyur sbyor ldan zhesaḥ 'di la 'bad cing lhur blang nas re zhig goms 'dres rtags 'byung tshe a ru dza sug li shi dang gur gum ka ra bur sbrang rnamasaḥ 'bri brgya'i mar la bsre sbyar shing ril bu kha 'bu tsam du byaḥ dang po lnga yis lto rten byaX rim bzhin mar phri gcig pu dngaḥ rlung sbyor bsgrags na bcud len 'grubaḥ tshe rgyas bkrags 'bar nyams rtogs 'phelaḥ 'byung lngar dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul grubaḥ mkha' la spyod cing sa 'og rgyuḥrig 'dzin gral ru e ma hoX sa ma yuX rgya rgya rgyaḥ zab pa'i man ngag rlung sbyor dang bcud len gyi gnad bstan pa'i chingasaṣ+ṭṛ ye shes chen po bar rlung giḥ sbyor ba la ni 'bad pa dang spang rgyan dkar po shu dag dngaḥ chu rtsi bzang drug bsres pa yiX dud pa sna bug rkyang mar drangs bum pa chil brgyangs dngas mar bstims0 shes rab srog tu shar ba yiḥ

yas 1 dbyangs yig tsakra 'dus mdor gsal de yi steng 'og dhiḥhrīḥ las skyes pa'i shes rab lha sku dmigs yum gyi dri ba gang 'dod sgrogs thabs kyis gsang gnad 'byed par mosaḥ shes rig der gtad bar rlung bskyil dhe hrīX 'byung 'jug rlung dang bsgrags mnal tshe rten 'brel legs nyes 'char ༷ ha cing mi smra gsang nyams 'changaḥ mkha' 'gro khros pas bka' chad stonaḥ 'dzoms bag gzu bor gnas par byaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgyaX zab pa'i man ngag rlung spyor dang rten 'brel rmi lam brtags gnad bstan pa'i chings3niḥ khab len lcags kyis dril lam rta rkang gsum mthil la pha waṃ dang 'phar ba kha sha gsum gyi khragaḥ bsres pas re ti yeḥzhes bkod khong par dbugs sgro srub med dang kya rta shel shing ar nag giX 'khor lo rtsibs dang ldan par byaḥ mthing shun ljang ma'i byang bu laX re ma ti ye ye 'ur 'ur rgyugs rgyug gling bzhi rlabs skor gyiḥ rkang pa ye cho mdur rung po sbril chun 'iḥ 'bum phrag re bzlas sngags btab poX dbugs sgro dang sprol sna lnga la rang gi ro rkyang lam dang 'brel sbyor ba bzhi nga

bar gyi rlungaḥ phan tshun bskyil dgangs gnad gcun pasaḥ dang po rten nas sgrid pa gtong bar ru mtsher skad 'don pa dang tha ma rtse gar 'byung ba'i tshe grub pa'i rtags su nges pa'oḥ shin tu gsang zhing rang nyams sbyaraḥ brtson 'grus che na nges par 'byungaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya0 zab pa'i man ngag rlung spyor dang rkang mgyog sgrub gnad bstan pa'i tshengasasnyi sgom pa rlung gi 'khrul 'khor canaX sngon 'gro yan lag dgu dang ldan khams rdul 'byung ba'i rdul dang bsre thams cad dbyings kyi 'khor lo laX rang yan lta ba'i nga skyong ngoḥ dngos gzhi sbyor ba bzhi ldan pasaX 'gros gsum gar dang ldan pa yisaḥ mnyam bzhag gnad kyi 'khrul 'khor dang rdzes thob ye shes rlung sbyar ste0 sgom pa'i gnad du nges pa'oḥ rjes su gtum mo sbar ba dang bdud rtsi zhu ba'i mthus drangs nasaX 'khor lo bzhi yi lha tshogs bskangasaX snang gsal dga' rig ye shes mthong0 zag dang zag med lhan skyes zhal bcu drug gsum gyi thabs des drangs de la steng sgo 'ju 'dul grags cig char sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor laX khams gsum rol pa zhes su 'byung rdo

yas 1 rje pad+mor brtse ba na rlangs pa mtsho ru reg tsam nasaḥ rlung gis btegs te rang gnas bzlogaḥ gegs bsal rma bya'i gar bskor dngaX seng chen 'gying dang glang po 'khyugasaḥ cang shes rgal 'dril chu 'thung gsumaḥ a 'bebs ram̐ sbar mgo cog dngaḥ btegs dang thog dang bar gyi 'bebs gsum gyis gegs rnams bsal bar byaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaX zab pa'i man ngag rlung sbyor dang gegs bsal bog 'don bstan pa'i chings3)༷ khyad par stong 'khor bla bre 'diX brtul zhugs sgom pa'i bu la bstanaḥ ras dkar dri bral kha gang dor ཿ mthing dang chos sman bsres pa yisaḥ mi khyud rim pa lnga ru bskoraḥgu ru thod phreng sde lnga niḥ brtul zhugs gar bsgyur cang te'u dngaḥbhan+ta brten zhing rus rgyan sprasaḥ de ni dbus kyi 'dab lngar bkodaḥ gnyis par rin chen dang po yisaḥ dbyangs gsal lañdza warti byaḥ gsum par mtshal gyi bla sgrub kyiX bsnyen gsum dbu can tsheg med bkodaḥ bzhi par thig phreng brgyad cu laX shin tu phra ba rdo rjes mdzes rgya snag bzang drug sbyar bas bkodaX lnga par rdo rje zer phreng briX bsnyen sgrub

yas 1 rtag tu bkur zhing srung mdzad pa'i dpal gyi khyi spyang bcu drug dngaX pho nya dmus long rgyab 'brel tshogasaḥ 'brug bzhi dra ba glog 'gyu maḥ 'khor bcas dam tshig gnas 'dir byon ya dag nges pa'i lung 'di nyonaX bdud rtse sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ mnyam nyid don la mos pa bskyedaḥ phyi nab gsang ba'i bar chad bzlogaḥdangos grub sgrub pa'i brin las stsol tha tshig ma g.yel sa ma yāḥ oṃ kro te shwa ri pañtsa amṛ ta rak+ta ba la ta kha hiḥtri pa tri pa hūṃ phaṭaḥ kha la ro sha kha la ro sha hūṃ phaṭaḥ yasna ku baṃ dza yakra ku baṃ dza hūṃ phaṭaḥ dz+wa la ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa dz+wa la a mu ka a mu ka hūṃ phaṭaḥ a dṛ ta rak+ta ba lirnyi khā hiḥ de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni nyo dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi bka' yi 'khor na gnas pa'i dpal gyi khyi spyang bcu drugaḥ pho nya dmus long rgyab 'brel dab tsug 'brug gzhi 'dab brgyad ༷ bka' 'khor dam tshig la gnas pa thams cad kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes laḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungasaḥ sems can la phan bde spelaḥ 'khor 'das kyi dpal

yon dang bcud ma lus par bsdus te dngos kun bdud rtsi'i stobs su stsol ba dang phrin las rnams pa bzhi gang brtsam pa'i don thams cad thogs med yid bzhin tu stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cigaḥ phud skyems mched cing phrin las bcol gang 'dod yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyuraḥs ma shāḥskabs su nyul le bskrad chog ni mdun du ye lathangalcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du tre las sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri nyul le thams cad nyam thag pa'i gzugs can ru gsal laḥ bden bo da ni na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i mthusaḥ sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dam sri nyul le nag po bdud kyi phyogs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten ming gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cigatre ā ga ya dza dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gsum lnga bdun dgu gang rung brjod rdo rje glu yis 'ad skad doḥ( dzaḥ ye yi tshogasakyi dkyil 'khor du 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa laḥ khros pa'i yid kyis bskul na zag pa'i bsod nams phung po 'jig ཿ ma rung gdon la smos ci dgos bdud rtsi lnga'am

ra 1 rdzas lnga laḥ gzugs dang ming rus bcas nas su ma nya bskul te phur pas gdabaḥ rdul du rlog nas tshogs su 'bul ༷ rdo rje khrag 'thung 'khor bcasakyis ru dra spyom grum chem chem rolaḥ bskal bar g.yo ldeng med par gyis ༷ snye gha gha gha ta ya sarba du ṣ+ṭan pāṭa pāṭaX ki li ki la sarba pa paṃ phaṭaḥ badz+ra da rod a dzñā pa ya ti sarbabighan kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī li gī la ya hūṃ phaṭaX snyen gru bu a pa tse ru tse na ra tse tsa me thunaḥ ngan shi stum bha yakaḥ bi na ya gaḥ phye ma phye maḥ rdul phran rdul phran tsit+ta rbad stumabha ya nanaḥ ma ra ya nanaḥ thum ri li liḥ e nyung thum dza rbad sodaḥ de ltar dus drug gam ni bzhir gnas du bsnun pa shin tu gces sa ma yā skabs su sman mchod 'bul ba niḥ āḥ(ཿdum gshug bhan+ta mtshan ldan yangs pa'i nang sha lnga bdud rtsi mnyam par sbyor ba'i skyems ཿ rigs lnga yab yum byin gyis brlabs pa'i bcud ༷ dkar dmar byang chub sems bcud bla namedaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i a mṛ taḥ rgyal ba rgya mtsho thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzasaḥ zag med yid bzhin sprin gyi phung por gyur zhi ātshu sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ trīX 'i

rgyal dgongs brda snyan shog ser tshig gi brgyudaX bka' bab smon lam chu bo drug ldan gyi bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol ma hā pañtsas bṛ ta la kha ram̐ khā hi pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung he ru ga bka' dgongs phur gsum mdo rgyu sems phyogs kyiḥ yi dam rgyud sde rab 'byams rgya mtsho la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsalaḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha dza khā+e hi bde mchog kye rdor gsang ba 'dus pa dang ma hā ma ya dus kyi 'khor lo dngaX mkha' spyod dbang mo rgyud sde'i gsang mdzod la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a bṛ ta la kha ram̐khā hi masto ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dngaX ka la sirnyi shakya de wa dngaX bkra shis khyed 'dren 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaX ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha ro khā hi rgyud mgon legasaldan tshogs kyi bdag po dang spyan gcig khrag khol bya rog gtsug 'dzin rgyalaX dbang chen bka' 'khor pho nya rgya mtsho la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaX ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta la kha ram̐

yas / khā hi dngos kun bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i nye lam laḥ mthun rkyen legs tshogs sbyor ba'i dam tshig canaḥ sman srung rdo rje'i pho nya thams cad laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta la kha ram̐ khaṃ hiḥ snang srid rnam par dag pa'i mkha' dbyija sa suX bde spyod rdo rje'i gsang srog 'chang mdzad pa'i 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha ram̐ khā hi grub pa mchog gi yon tan mthar phyin teḥganyis med gnyas su 'dzin pa'i 'ching rgya grolaḥ bde mnyam bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor gsang lam laḥ bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro ba byang chub sgo gaḥ ra sa ya na pañtsa a dṛ ta a la la hoḥ gnas gsum bdud rtsi'i thig le byug sku gsum yon tan mchog thob 'gyur sa ma yāXskabs su rak+ta gnad dbab niḥ( (ཿ gu gul byin bskyed gdug pa'i dpa' skongs shing srasaphur gdab pas rten 'brel mtshan ma stongaḥ rak+ta phyar bas gnas yul pho nya bskulaḥ dpal chen stobs basmed drag po las la bskulaḥ shes badz+ra rak+ṣa 〉ཿ karma duṣ+ṭa phaṭaḥ a la la bh+yoX

o badz+ra ko ri ha rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ sa badz+ra rtso'u ri haX rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ o badz+ra pra mo haḥ rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ obadz+ra be ta li haḥ rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ o badro puṣ+ka si haḥ rak+ta ha he phaṭaX o badz+ra ra ri haḥ rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ o badz+ra tsan+ta li haḥ rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ ma badz+ra sme sha ni nya rak+ta ha he phaṭa oṃbaju he he mu kha bh+yoḥ rak+ta ha he phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra te dz+ra te nga dz+ra rak+ta ha he phaṭa ces badz+ra shwa ra mu tra rje ཿ ha he rak+ta pāṭaḥ gnas ma yul ma dbang phyug rnams rtag tu bdud rtsa sgrub pa'i grogs ma gdung bu la brtse bzhin 'grogasaḥnyams rtogs yon tan 'phel bar 'gyuraḥs ma wā de nas bshags pa 'bul ba niḥ ho skye med chos sku'i dbyings su byang chub kyang ༷ ma 'gags ye shes gzigs pa'i gzi byin gyis gang 'dul phrin las thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes bdag bzung mdzod lta ba dman zhing rtogs pa bogs ma thonaḥ man ngag snying po ma lon rmongs pas sgribaḥ sor byang sngags sdom nyams pa'i nyes lhung kunaḥ ye shes thugs kyi dbyings su bzod par gsol sgrib med mkha' ltar dag pa'i dngos grub stsolaX yi dam dbang chen bde ba'i gzi byin can pad+ma gar dbang gnyis

yas 1 med mnyam pa'i dbyingasaḥ thabs shes zung 'jug yi dam rgyud sde'i dpal: ma lus brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongasaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi'i lta spyodabogs ma thonaX mtshan 'dzin rtog pa grol ba'i gdengs ma byungaḥ gtsang sme ro snyoms ngang la rtogs pa byungaX thams cad bde chen rgyal po'i dgongs klong bshags ye nas bde stong phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor laḥ gnyis med 'khor 'das bde bar sbyor med kyangaX gdul bya'i re 'dod mi nub bskang ba'i phyir ma dang mkha' 'gro brtse ba chen pos dgongs ye nas mi dmigs ka nas dag pa'i 1ngaḥ rig pa gcig pu 'khor 'das gsang sgog canaX lhun grub bde chen spros bral mnyam rdzogs klongaḥ ma rtog rmongs pa'i dri ma mthol lobashagasaḥ mtha' bral lta ba'i zhun 'thar ma chod cing blo bral sgom par rtog pas 'khris bslad zhugasaX rnam rgyal spyod pa'i klong la rtsis gdab byasaḥ gang yang ma dmigs chosakyi dbyings su bshagasaḥ bshags bya bshags byed spros pa ka dag pasaḥ ye nas mtha' bral thig le'i klong yangs suḥ gzung 'dzin srid pa'i 'ching rgya kun bral bar mi

dmigs chos kyi dbyings su gshags bgyi'o mkha' ltar dag pa'i 1nga du bzod par bzhes sgrib med me long gsal ba'i dngos grub stsolaX chos nyid don la mnyam parabazhag byas teḥrdo rje'i gsung mchog yi ge brgya bzlas pas rtsa lhung yan lag chag nyams dri ma byang sgrib bral rdo rje'i gsang lam mngon tu 'gyur sa ma yu skabs su sa bzhi'ibaskang ba 'bul ba niḥhū nyiḥ dmigs med mkha' gtaing bral ba'i klong yangs nas ye shes gzigs tshul ma 'gags rtsa ba gsumaX sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i zhal bzang bu la ngoms tshogs chen mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a dṛ ta grub pa mtha' ru phyin phyir 'bul gyi bzhes chags pa rab bsgral rak+ta dmar chen po rten 'brel dbyings su stong phyir 'bul gyis bzhes 'dod ye ro bcud ldan pa'i ba lidhaḥ zhen 'dzin ka nas dag phyir 'bul gyi bzhesaḥ ye shes 'od stong ldan pa'i mar me'adi ma rig mun khams sang phyir 'bul gyis bzhes dam rdzas med byung dza gad stems mchod 'diḥ 'khyal ba ka nas dag phyir 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ a la la ho bde stong

ra / — rtogs pa rgyas sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i sa thob shogaX de ltar phul ba nyams sor chud cang tshogs chen rab rdzogs don gnyis lhun gyisagrub sam māḥde nas dngosagrub bskul bar bya ba niḥ / hrīḥ rdzebatsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ dpa' bo ging dang rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnga yab gling nas thug rjes nye bar dgongs sgrub pa po la dngos grub char ltar phobaX rab 'bar dbang chen e yi klong dkyil nasaḥ rta phag zung 'jug ye shes gsal ba'i skuḥ dpa' bo pho tshogs dpa' mo ma tshogs rnamasaX bde chen klong yangs ngang las 'dir byon laX dngos kun bdud rtsir grub pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ 'bum phrag yongs kyi tshogs rje wā ra hi bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas mtsho rgyal maḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro nyi rdul grangs mnyam bcasaḥ skye med dbyings las 'gags med gzugs skur ngoms bde stong spros mtha' bral ba'i dngos grub stsolaX thugs la le lo btang snyoms mi mdzad par sgrab pa zab mo mtha' ru phyin lags pasaḥ dngos grab zab mo dus las mi g.yel bar da lca nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol rtsa sngags mthar ka ya siji oṃḥ

wāk+ka sidhi aḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ sarba sirnyi hrīḥ brgya rtsa brjod la bstod tshig gi mchod bstod bya'o zo rangasalasagazhung bsrang la bskang tshogs 'bulapho nya gsol mchog nyuste bskrad chog bya byin chen dbab cing 'dzab bskul sman mchod 'bul bdag 'jug rim pa las byang mtha' ltar bya sku gsu thugs dbang dbang rdzogs ltar du bskuraḥthod rdzas rigs lnga tshe rdzas sna tshogs pa dngos grub tshul du rol te 'di skad do hū hrīḥ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje tshe yi dbang dam ldan sgrub pa po la rtsal du gsol rdo rje'i mkha' dbying rlabs kyis gcod byed pa'iX mthu ldan gshogs pa'i dngos grub stsal tu gsol rgya mtshor mi byang thogs med brgal nus pa'iX shugs ldan mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsolaX phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad pa gang brtsam kyangaḥ thogs med 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥchen btsan dregs pa las la 'chun pa yiḥ nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ sems ni rang byung ye shes ngo bor sminaḥ med byung rtogs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsol tshe gcig gzhon nu bum skur byang chub pa'i yid bzhin grub pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsolaX hūṃ sirnyi pha la a la la hoḥ sman gyi dngos grub khog bzhung ltar du len phrin mtha'

tsis 1 geḥ dbyings phyug bde ba'i tshul du gnas: lnga gnyis zung du sprad pa lasaḥ bde ba chen po sbyin pa'i rgyaḥ gnyis med gcig tu shar ba'i skuḥ thabs kyi rang bzhin rta mgrin dkar gri gug thod khrag bsnol thabs 'dzinaḥ ral gseb rta zhal hi hi sgrogasaḥ dur khrod rus rgyan me dpung bzhugasaḥ rdo rje phag mo dmar gsal mdzesaḥ gri thod 'dzin zhing yab la 'khyudaX spyi bor phag zhal nag po nguraḥ gzig sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs sprasaḥ ye shes 'od kyi zer chen 'khrigasaḥ bde dang stong pa'i rol pa lasaḥbyang chub sems kyi 'du 'phro yisaḥ rgyal ba sras bcas gzi byin bskulaḥ 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i da sa bcud drilaX ye shes bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing kun nas mnyam pa chen por 'khyilaḥphyogs bzhi pad+ma nyi zla'i stengaḥ rigs bzhi khrag 'thung yab yum brgyadaX kun kyang he ru ka pa'i chasaX 'khril sbyor bde ba'i gzi byin 'baraḥ byang chub sems kyi 'du 'phro rgyasaḥ kun kya mnyam nyid chen por bzhugs de rgyab nyi zla rū tra'i kharaX las bzhi'i rtags 'dzin king chen bzhi rus pa'i gzugs can ha ha dgod dpa' bo 'bod

pa'i rnge'u chung brdungaḥ ḍāk+ki bskul ba'i drel g.yer sgrogasaḥ las byed dpa' rtags ru dar mjes mkha' la thogs med stobs kyis 'gro ra sa ya na'i phrin las sgrubaX sgo bzhir dus sbyor chen mo bzhisaḥ 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dngas bcud sdud phrin las bzhi yi byed por bsngagasaḥ gcer bu bde stong bzi 'od 'baraḥ ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na 'gyingaX snang stong zung 'jug chen por bskyed kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bru las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas rigs lnga yab yum rnam pa —3 spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas gdab gyuraḥ sa āḥ(ཿ yo hūṃ swā zhe sna hūṃ rmā māṃḥbye rtaḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+raX slar yang rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo kun phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs dam tshig dngaḥ ye shes 'khor lor gnyis med bsreḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ bzhung bgo bstod pa'i mjug bar gtong de nas sman srung spyan 'dren ni spos dkar tsa na ka ko la'i dud btang bzang drug phud mchod de hā trī sngon tshe dngos grub bsgrubs pa'i tshe dpal chen he ru'i rgyal po dngaX grub pa'i rig

yas / 'dzin thams cad kyiX spyan sngar khas blangs dam mnos pa'iX ra sa ya na'i srung ma niḥ lha klu drang sgong tshangs dbang dngaḥ rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i lha mo rnams dam tshig dgongs te da tshur byonaḥ rnal 'byor rtogs ldan bdag nyid kyis0 gtsang dang sme bar 'dzin pa bcomaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir dngas du len sha chen lnga po mnyam nyid spyod bdud rtsi lnga yi rtog pa brjodaḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bzhengs brin las gdul bya'i khams la 'bebasaḥ de yi grogs su khyed cag gis phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrubasaḥ lha klu drang srong mi yul gyiḥ 'byung lnga'i dngas bcud dpal yon kun thabs kyis bkugs nas stobs su drilaḥ rtags mtshan bzang po ma g.yel ston sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma yā stumaḥ de nas sman phud mchod byas nas rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i gdengs bskyed doḥ e ma hoX dgongs shig rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs ༷ yang dag nges pa'i lung 'di nyon tshangs dbang drang srong gtsang ma zaḥ lha gla bram ze gtsang ma za byol song rtswa mchog za ba yangaX gnyis med gnyis su rtogs bya'i phyir: de dag grol ba ngas ma bshad rnal

'byor rtogs ldan chen po yis gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin bral ba rtsabyang chub sems ni rdo rje cheḥsha chen mchod pa rin chen rigs pad+ma me tog yang dag ldan rdo rje'i chu ni lasakyi mchogaḥ zas mchog tshe yi dri chen poḥ ga bur shel kyi spos phor dri rin chen me ltar 'bar ba'i 'odaX gcig tu dpa' bo'i ro rnams kunaḥ gnyis su med par mnyam sbyoranasaX rgyal ba'i dkyil 'amar chen por sgrub dngos grub chen por dang du blang0 de dag yongs su grol bar 'gyuraḥ phud kyis bde gshegs sras bcas mchodaX dngas mas rtsagasum thugs dam bskangasaḥ las su khyed cag gnad la dbabaX bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i 11gas mdzod cig sa ma yā dza sa ma ya hring sa ma ya stum de nas bzlas pa'i 'byul 'khor nibadag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can spros teḥ mdun bskyed bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskulaX thug rje byin rlabs dbang dang dngosagrub thams cad dam tshig gi rdzas la sib sib thimaḥ gnyis su med par 'dresaḥ 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon dngas bcud thams cad bsdus te yang yang bstim0 ye shes kyi

cas 1 bdud rtsi chen por gyur bar dmigs la yin ātuḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa ya na ta na dza ya gu h+ya sirnyi hūṃ trīḥ'i dam tshig gzung thag la brten nas ting 'dzin spro bsdu yangayang bya slar yang stong tshig mchod bstod byed bdud rtsi' lha tshogs thams cad kun 'od zhu dam tshig rdzas la bstims de ni zhi ba sku sgrub kyi rnal 'byor dam pa e ma ho sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa longs sku sgrub pa na yis pho brang mtha' dbus mi dmigs paḥ kun nas zlum pa chos kyi dbyingasaḥ dag gsal bde ba chen po'i mdangasaḥ zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas khangaX sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyidardzogasaḥ de dbus pad nyi zla ba'i stengaX sha lnga bdud rtsi che ba'i mchogaḥ mtshan mar 'dzin pa bsreg gtor bkrusaḥ rigs lnga yab yum ngo bor gyuraḥ dbang chen bde ba'i dkyila'akhor niḥ khya ṣ+ṭṛ wa sku mdog dmaraḥ zhi ma khro 'dzum gzi 'od 'bar ༷ stag sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs mdzesaḥ thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyanaḥ dar sna'i cod pan 'ja' ltar 'khyugs dmar ser ral ba'i skra gseb tu rta mgo ljang zhur hi hi sgrogs dregs pa sde brgyad dam la 'dogs rngog ma leb rgan me ltar 'baraX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro las la

'chun sbyan gsum lta stangs ha rer gzigs snang srid 'khor 'das mnga' dbang bsgyuraḥ phag mo skrun nag sku la 'khrilaḥ bde dang stong pa'i gzi 'od 'bar: rus rgyan gzigs sham dar dpyangs sprasaḥ gnyis ka gri thod 'khrud stobs rol 'od lnga me dpung rol thabs bzhugs snang stong ye shes 'od skur bskyedaḥ g.yas na dpa' bo pho tshogs kyis 'byung bzhi srid pa'i dpal yon sdud g.yon na dpa' mo mo tshogs kyisaX bde gshegs mchod cing gzi byin bskul mdun na ging dang lang ka yisaX gnas yun dur khrod tshogs ston 'gugs rgyan nas dbang phyug nor lha yis srid pa'i dpal yon dngas bcud bstim lha klu drang srong rig 'dzin gyis rtog pa brjod cing las la nyulaḥ kun kyang ye shes klong yangs dang rnam rol du ma ngo bo gcig dbang chen gtso 'khor thams cad kyi srog gis bskul te ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstimaḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod cing bstod 'dzab kyi dmigs pa gong ltar la dbang chen bde ba'i bsnyen sngags niḥ 31 badz+ra kro ti h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa hu lu hu lu badz+ra dzña na pañtsa kro ta pañtsa a mṛ ta sirnyi hūṃḥ smra bcad ting 'dzin

༄rngo11 bstan po yis ye shes dbab bstim nan du bya des ni gsung gi rdo rje 'grub rtogs ldan rnal 'byor spyod yul loḥs ma wāḥrgya rgya rgya gsum pa chos skur sgrub pa niḥye mi gnas chos sku debazhin nyidaX kun khyab rang gsal bde chen klong dbang chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong duḥ chos dbyings 'gyur med gzhal yas khangaḥ mthing gsal bde ba'i da la sa mi bskyod nyima'i dkyil 'khor steng lnga gnyis mnyam pa rigs kyi rdzas rin chen nyi zla'i kha chod stengaX rdo rje rgya gram mdzes pa'i skuḥ thugs mchog mi 'gyurarta mgrin mazeng shes rab phagamo yum dang rol gnyis ka bhan+ta bdud rtsi 'dzin rta phag zhal gyi dkyil 'khor las du tra 'dul bas bzhad ngur sgrogasaḥ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug spras zhi ma khro 'dzum gzi 'od 'baraX bde dang stong pa'i cho 'phrul lasaḥ 'od zer phyogs bcu kun du sprosaḥ 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dpal yon kunaḥ bde chen bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkugasaḥ yab yum sku gsung thugs dang 'dresaX bzhengs stabs gar gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems bcud dkar dmar babaX dam tshig rdzas dang gnyis med gyuraḥ gnas lnga rtsa

'khor thig le'i klong: zhi khro rtsa gsum dam can rnams til gyi gong bu phyur bzhin gsalaX kun kyang bde stong gzi 'od 'bar gnyis med rol pa'i bcud chen po ye shesalngayi gzi 'od 'baraḥ dam tshig rdzas dang gnyis med bsreḥ gnasagasum 'od kyis ye shes paḥ pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnamasaḥ phyag rgya yig 'byu phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kha ba bu yug bachinaX spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med bsreḥ 'a ma ya ho sa ma yā stamaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ las gzhung bsrang la bstod pa' mthar 'dzab dmigs gong dang mthun pa la thugs mchog ye shes bzlos pani snyen badz+ra kro ta dzñā na gu h+ya kro ti shwa ri hūṃ phaṭaḥ ting 'dzan g.yo med chos sku' ngang gang 'dod phrin las sde kha bskuraḥ des ni thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub rten 'byung bslu med dus su 'charaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya bsgopa smon gyi sgrom lnga so gtags btsag bsre sbag sbyar grub nas dar lnga'i sgod blugs rgya yis gdabs bde skyong thabs shes zhal sbyor sgomaḥ g.yo med rin chen snod du gzhugs chab dang chang gi nying khu blugs shing rtsi sman dri 'thul babakrams rlangs pa mi 'pho kha chod dang sku chings rdor dril dam rtags rgya rig lnga'i srog zhu gzu sa thag bcas mañdza'i khar bkod thod snyed bri bde ba'i rang bzhin a lo ke phyogs lnga mdzes pa'i tshul du phul tshil chen dud spro

sa je 1 sbyar spos bdug zhang chen g.yang gzhi mda' dar dang phyar dar g.yab dar sna tshogs sprugs rol mo thod rnga rkang gling dang sba dkar bshug pa sog kyi sgras byin chen drag tu dbab par byaḥ/ hrīḥ yis rgyan steru ka dpal gyi dur khrod mchog la dpe blangs nasaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi da la bzhengasaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi che ba'i mchogaḥ byang chub sems kyi dang las byung don ni skye'achi gnyis med grubaX ngang ni mnyam pa nyid du gnas las ni rgyud lnga'i sems can sgrol don ni dug lnga rnam par dgaḥ ye shes lnga ru e ma ho deden lhun grub dkyil 'khora'adiraḥ byin chen rnams kyi byin phob cigaX dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur cigaḥ rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po stenaḥ ra sa ya na'i dngos grub stsal sa ma yā hoḥ pañtsa sa maya stumaX pañtsa a dṛ ta dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ces brjod dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod dang dur khrod brgyad dang rig 'dzin gyi byin phab nyul le bsgrad chog bya sman srung gnad dbab rtog pa bsal/rak+ta cher gsum dgongs pa skyongs de na gnyis med mnyam pa'i las shin tu dam rgya byas te sgrubaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya lnga pa bdud rtsi rlan sgrub na yin rang byang busmo stong gsum mnyam pa'i khyonaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi

lnga yis rnam par gtamasaX lhun grub thod pa'i snyed pu gsum steng gnas ཿ shar gyi thig le rlung gi dkyil 'khor ye g.yas kyi tshom bur me yi ngo bo ram̐ḥ g.yon gyi dal du bde stong a shad mdzesaḥ rang srog 'od kyi me rlung mnyam sbyor bskulaX thod pa dros te sha lnga bdud rtsi zhu rlangs pa 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas mchod dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus te bstimaḥ rdzas kyi rang zhin bde gshegs rig lnga'i dal mi bskyod rdor sems rin 'byung mtha' yas dang don grub mthing dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i tshul longs sku'i chas rdzogs ye shes 'od kyi skuḥ rigs lnga'i rtags 'dzin gang 'dul phrin las 'gyed:ngo bo dmigs med mkha' ltar dag mod kyang rang bzhin lhun grub sgyu ma'i brda chos tsam rten 'brel rdzas la rtogs kyi dbang byin phob bla hūṃ swā ā sna brgya rtsa brjodaḥhrīḥ phyi ni sgod pa nang ni gzhal yas khang sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid phun tshogs dbus dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i a mṛ taḥ rang byung sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par bsreḥ gnyis med don la 'tshe ba'i 'byung po rnamasaḥ ta ki ra tsa'i stobs kyis sma

chas 1 phab nas 'dod pa'i rgyal pos phyogs skyong zil gyis gnonaḥ ye shes khro bo bcu yi bsrung 'khor gtamasaXshā hūṃ snyisha badz+ra kho mi tsakra phaṭaḥ dz+wa la dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa (ཿ dbang chen pad+ma 'bar ba e yi sangaḥ chags med bde stong zung 'jug nyi zla'i kharaḥ khams gsum dbang sdud srid pa chos skur brdalaḥ mthar byed gzhon nu rta mchog rol pa'i skuḥ dbu dgu phyag kyang rnam pa bco brgyad tshulaḥ gtum rngams dus me 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs can g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tha ler gzigs pa'i zhal dmar ser ral dbus rta mgo ljang zhur lasaḥ nga ro dgu sgrogs dregs tshogs zil gyis gnonaḥ sde brgyad dam 'dogs ma rung glad pa 'gemaḥ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril sbyan rnams glog ltar 'khyugs drag po'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogasaḥ g.yas kyi phyag brgyad bde sbyin pad+ma bsnamasaḥ g.yon gyi phyag brgyad bhan+ta bdud rtsi 'dzinaḥ rtsa phyag rdo rje dril bu bsnol thabs basbyaraḥ thod skams dbu rgyan rus pa'i rgyan drag spasaḥ zhabs rnams bsgad pas bdud bzhi gnon par byedaḥgasang ba rigs kyirtags ldan rnam pa

bzhi khro gnyer mi pham ro lengs ral gcig bzhir0 bde ba chen por 'khril sbyor rol rtsed bsgyuraḥ bde gshegs kun kyang byang chub sems kyis mchod ye shes gsang ba thugs kyi klong du bsreX phyogs bcu khro bor sprul te gdug pa sgrol bde stong yum gyi bha gar mnyam nyid sbyoraX phyag rgya chen po'i phrin las rlab po cheḥ dus la ma g.yel tshad med rnams pa bzhes dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i las rnam stsolaḥ nam mkha'i mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor kunaX dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi gsang bar sbyor bde legs dga' ba bzhi yi char chen po zag med ye shes chen po gcig tu bskyilaX slar yang lha tshogs gnas gsum yig 'bru lasaX 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag yas 'phrosaḥ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcasaḥ spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med ro gcig gyuraḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya stumaḥ spyan 'dren nas bzung bstod mthar gtong de nas bzlas pa'i 'byul 'khor ni bdag thugs 'od kyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskulaX rlung gis me sbar me yis thod pa drosaḥ bdud rtsi khol zhing rlangs pas rigs lnga bskulaX dge las

4rngo 1 ni 'od 'phros gsung gi dalaḥdabang chen yab yum sku gsung thugs rgyud bskulaḥ thugs ga'i ye shes sems dpa'i sgog sngags 'khoraX bde stong spros dang bral ba'i gzi 'od 'baraX sbyor ba bzhi de dag las ni 'od zer sprosaḥ 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dpal yon dngas bcud dang bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs byin rlabasaḥ ma lus bsdus te gsung gi dal dang bsresaḥ byang chub sems bcud dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chu klung drag po ltar bab rdzas la bstemaḥ zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyilaX byin khyabs zegs ma bdag bskyed thugs gar regaḥ mchog thun dbang byin daro sa grub thob par dmigasaḥrta phag thugs dang rang sems gnyis su medaḥganyis med dam tshig gzungs kyi thag pas sbrelaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mthar thug klongaḥ rig stong rta phag zhal sbyor dgongs nyams skyongasatshan ā& badz+ra a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥtha yengs med rig pa' ting mdzan gyis stong gsum dbang gi dal du bsduḥsnye ste/ dhi cit+ta spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ se ha ra ṇa (ཿ dzña na dhartu a pra ta sirnyi trīḥ bya chub sems kyis spro bsdu yis dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rnal

'byor 'grubaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bdag thugasa'od kyis sman gyi dkyil 'khor bskulaX de las 'od 'phros lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kun gyi sbyor mtshams byang chub sems kyi sprin phyogs bcu'i zhing khyab bde gshegs sras bcas mchod zhi khro rab 'byams til gong phyur bzhin phyonaX bdud rtsi steng gi nam mkhar 'od dkyil bzhugasaḥ kun kyang bde stong chen por snyoms zhugs nasaḥ bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi char bab nasaḥ brdal khyab bhan+ta mer gyis gang bar dmigs rlangs pa'i 'od kyis 'khor ba dongs nas sprugs snang srid 'byung bzhi'i dpal yon dngas bcud bstim phrin las rnam bzhin gdul bya 'dul bar dmigasaX tshangs dbang lha klu drang srong rig 'dzin dang rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i lha mo thams cad kyis zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char phab nasaḥ rang byung bhan+ta ltem gyis gang bar dmigasaX o badz+ra a dṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sarba panyu pra we sha ya phophem hūṃ trīX 'iX ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i 'dzab mchod 'bul dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor 'grubaḥ sa ma māḥ bdag thugs 'od kyis bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dang mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud

yas 1ཿ bskulaḥ kun gyi sku las rang 'dra'i ye shes paḥ nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin bdud rtsi'i steng du sprosaḥ kun kyang rol pa chen po'i sbyor mtshams nasaḥ gsang babyang chub sems bcud 'od lnga yiḥ rnam par bab pas bhan+ta ltem gyis gangaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs dmigasaḥ sasnyen āhūṃḥsarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ hrīḥ'iḥbasnyen sgrub las sbyor rtags tshad gtong sku 'grub ḍak+ki daro sa su mazong gsung 'grub rtags su lha sngags thos thugs 'grub rtags su zer 'od 'khrug yon tan rtags su mar me 'bar gtor ma lud cing dri bza 'thul phrin lasartags su bdud rtsa 'phel rtags 'byung zhen med rangs sar 1da 'grab na spob chog bya ba'oḥrnal 'byor rig pa'i brtul zhugs skyongs thun bsdu tshe na lha tshogasarnams 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rol bar dmigs sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya drug pa bdud rtsa dbang byed niḥ rang ge thugs sgog 'od kyis mdun bskyed bdud rtsi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ dbang byin dngos grub kyi ngo bo gcig tu bsdus pa'i dal pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bruradabang chen te ru ka dmar gsal tshon gang ba rus pa'i rgyan drug can zhi ma khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan pa g.yas lcags kyu dang

g.yon bhan+ta bdud rtsi 'dzan paḥ thugs ka nas 'od zer lcag kyu'i dbyibs can dbang gi kha dog 'bar ba dpag yas su spros te bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems kyi dngas bcud malus pa bsdus shing dril te bdag bskyed kyi gnas rnams su thim pas dbang byin dngos grub ma lus pa yang yang bstim0 bdud rtsi'i dngas ma yar ba 'thor ba zhig pa ral bags pa thams cad kyang sor chud par byas nasaḥ rnal 'byor ba'i tshe daja ye shes yon tan thams cad kyi gsos su gyur bar dmigs la snyen dzñā na pañtsa a dṛ ta h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa hu lu husdo/ bhan+ta bhan+ta hūṃ āḥ dab byin daro sa grub ma lus pa 'od lnga'i rnam pa ra bsdus te bdag bskyed gnas lngar thim pa yas sku thugs yon tan phran las kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i dmigs dadun byaḥ sa ma pāḥ rgya rgya rgya ཿ de nasabaskul zhi gnad dbab niḥ (ཿ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku'i dbyings nyid las ye shes thugs rje gzigs pa mtha' yas dpalaḥ dbang chen pad+ma bde ba'i lha tshogs rnams bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rtags tshad legs par themaḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi bskangs lags naX rdo rje'i dam tshig sngon nas zhal bzhes ltaraX rnal 'byer bdag gis

yas /ཿ gsol ba drag tu 'debasaḥ thugs dam gnad bskul mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ sa ma ya bzhin rtags mtshan bzang po ston brin las myur ba nyid dubadag la stsolaX kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra rnal 'byor rdo rje lu gu rgyud da la bskor zhing sbyar spos spro rol mo yongs rdzogs glu yis bskul dar gdugs ba dan 'phan yab phyar sba dkar dang na bdug glu spir rdo rje rgyal po brtul zhugs kyi chas rnams bgo bzhan rta rgya yis sman gyi sgrom la reg byas re kun gyis mgrin glus 'di skad brjod yinamaḥ dpal chen nga dam ldan 'dasaḥ rū tra 'thar mdzad he ru ga dbang chen rta yibartul zhugs can0 sgrib med thugs kyis bdag la dgongasaḥ bdag cag rnal 'byer pho mo yisaḥgasang ba'i dkyil gsar chen po 'diraX bsnyen sgrub sgom bzlas mtha' ruphyinaḥ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la babaḥ khyad 'phags bstan pa'i dus la babaX mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la bab phrin las ma g.yelathugs dam can yang cig thugs dzobartse bas dgongasaḥ rtog pa las byung sems can gyiḥ sdug bsngal rgyu dang 'bras bu bcasaḥ ma lus bdag gis bsal nus phyiraḥ dngos

grub thugs kyi 1nga nas stsolaḥ bde bas phung ba'i nyam thag paḥ bde ba chen po thob bya'i phyiraḥ thugs mchog dpal gyis be'u nasaḥ bde stong spros bral dngos grub stsolaḥ gdug cing rtsub pa'i nag phyogs rnamasaḥ bdag ni thos dang dran tsam gyisaḥ zhi zhing bde legs thob bya'i phyir nus mthu stobs kyi dngos grub stsolaX dam pa chos kyis phongs ba'i yulaḥtheg pa'i rnam grangs ma lus pas smin cing grol bar bya ba'i phyiraḥ ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsolaX hū hrīḥ mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong yangs nasaX rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsolaX brjod med brda yi gsang mdzod nasaX 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub stsol gting gsal bum sku'i dkyil 'khor nasaX 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ rtag khyab mdzad pa rgya mtsho las yon tan re skong dngos grub stsol smon lam mtha' yas bum bzang las phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub stsolaḥ rig pa ye shes gar chen gyis chos nyid zhi ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ shes rab gsal ba'i sgron me yis nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsolaX rab tu gzigs pa'i ye shes kyisaḥ rlung sems dbang sdud

bde ba phun sum rgas par 'byur sam yu rgya rgya rgya denas gar+ṣa yo bya ba ni yeḥ dbang chen sa yilha mo'i mkha'aḥ bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i sangaḥ rin chen lnga yi gtor zed doX sa bcuda'aphel zhing rgyas gyur cig 'byu sna lnga yigator zed doḥ zas bcud 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cigaḥ sman sna lnga yi gtor dred do ༷ nad kyi bskal ba zhi gyur cig bdud rtsigilngaligator zed do dmag 'khrug rgud pa zhi gyur cigaḥ dar zab sna tshogs gtor zed doḥ gos rgyan 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig g.yang rdzas sna tshags gtor zed doḥ rdzogs ldan snangab rgyas gyur cigaḥ bkra shis g.yang rten gtor sgrub pasaḥ bkra shis yon tan dpal 'bar zhingaḥbade'agos snang ba rgyas gyur cigaX nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs nyin mtshan rtag tu phun tshogs regag pā snyi(rdogam le shes pa brjod cing me tog 'thoraḥsam yuḥrgya rgya rgya de nas bzod gsol 'bul ba ni bye lhag palilha mtshage pad+ma dbang gtso 'khorayongs rdzogs sprul dang bcasaX thugs rje brtse bas dgongs su gsolaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi'i nye lam la0 ngo mtshar mdzad spyod sgrub pa 'dir sku gsung thugs 'gal nyes

yas / sgrib las ci bgyis gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshagasaX bzod gsol bzhes la tshangs par stsolaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya bi shud+dhi aḥ yig brgyad bzlo zhing lhag ma bskangs de nas tho bsdu bya ba dang sman srung gshegs bsdu gawa ltar bya de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni glu chos sku skye med ngang nyid las 'gags med longs sku'i sprin phung po dbang chen bde ba'i gzi byin canaḥ myong grol bdud rtsi bsgrubs pa'i dal rang gnas bde ba chen por rluḥ slar yang mdzad pa mtha' yas stsolaḥ badz+ra muḥ yishes kyi'akhor lo chos kyi dbyings su bsdu'o dam tshig pa brin las lhun grub kyi 'khor lo'i rten tu gyuraX de nas bsngo smon gdab pa ni na ma dngos kun bdud rtsibasgrubs pa'i mthus nad kyi rgud pa zhi gyur cigaḥ dmag 'khrug mtshon chas gzengs pa dngaḥ mu ges rgud pa zhi bar shogaḥ sha za srin po gdug rtsub can gang yang byang chub sems ldan shogaḥ zug ngus mnar ba'i nyam thag kunaḥ thams cad bde bas 'tsho bar shogaḥ rgyal po'i chad pas bcing pa sogs thams cad myur du grol bar shogaḥ dbul po nyam thag 'gro ba laḥ longs sprod phun sum tshogs ldan shog gang

yang chos kyis phongs pa la sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgyas par re gaḥ sangs rgyas 'phags pa byang sems kyiḥ thugs bskyed smon lam rnam dag mthu mi mjed mtha' dbu'i kun khyab cing don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shogaḥ bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dngaḥ yi dam dbang chen byin rlabs dngaX gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bden stobs kyisaḥ 'khor ba dong nas sprug par 31gaḥ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyisaḥ gnas skabs bde legs dpal 'bar zhingaḥ mthar thug sku gsum rgyal sar spyod mdzad phrin nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam shog de ltar bsngo smon lan gsum gdab de nasashesab da bya ba ni na mo dbang dang byin rlabs kun kyi mdzod bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ dngos grub rgya mtsho stsol mdzad pa'i yi dam dbang chen bkra shis shog bde stong char 'bebs rtogs pa bskyed gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shogaḥ bstan pa dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis sgo ga 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sar sbyor ba'iX yang snying 'dus pa'i bkra shis regag gzhan yang shis brjod rgya chen byaḥs ma māḥrgya rgya rgya de na sku drinagaso ba na ye

yas / — ma ho phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdo rje slob dpon mchogaX thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol gnas snang o rgyan he ru'i zhing du bsgyuraḥ sgra tshig dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer bsgragasaX ye shes thugs kyi nyi ma klong nas gsalaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi mchog gi sgrub pa grubaḥ 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sa la smin par mdzad rgyu lam 'bras bu bde ba'i mchog gsang bstan 'phags yul grub pa'i mdzad pa rmad byung baX bdag cag rnams la stsal ba sku drin che stong gsum yon gyis gzhal bar mi 'os kyang rten 'brel tsam du yon dbul bzhes su gsolaḥ sku la mdzes pa lha gos pan tsa gsolaḥ ljags la dza gad ro ldan a dṛ bstabaḥ thugs byon yid 'ong phyag rgya rgyan ldan 'bul sgo gsum ltos med rig pa 'bul gyis bzhesaX tshe rabs kun tu thugs brtses rjes bzung zhing mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i smon lam 'grub par shogaḥ zhes dad phyag la zhing maṇ+ḍal rgya chen phul loḥs ma māḥrgya rgya rgya de nas mar me'i smon lam gdab pa na hoḥ dbang chen bde ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor duḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i mched lcam rnamasaḥ mi 'bral

'grogs pa'i dam tshig srog thob nasaḥ dbang gis smin cing sdom la gnas par shog0 log lam bar chad bdud kyis mi bsgyur zhingaḥ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i du kha rab skems nasaḥ bag chags gnas stong sa lam rtsal rdzogs teḥ rang snang don gyi zhing la spyod par shog bde mchog ston pa dbang chen he ru ga rdo rje'i gzungs ma gar dbang gzi ldan yumaḥ thugs sras rig 'dzin 'khor gyi tshom bu'i gralaḥ bdag kyang 'khod pa'i skal bzang thob par regagaḥ de ltar smon lam yang yang gdab dal bsdu rdul tshon chu ru gshegs shul du dri bzang chag chag gdab las rjes gzhan gyis mi mazo baḥyang dag gtsang ma nyid du bya bar chad gegs bral dgos pa cheḥ sam yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ e maḥrig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje yisaḥ mi 'gyur 'od gsal dgongs brda'i mdzod 'o yug dzo yi ra ba nas gcang btsan brtan ma she ge yis rten 'brel thabs kyi legs bskul tshe lce sgom nam mkha'arnal 'byor gyas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab rgya khrol dus tshag gsum dang 'brel ba sa yongs rdzogs bkra shis char ltar bab soḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyi zhes pa 'di'ang dge btsun thub dbang bya ba'ibakra shis dge ba'i skyes lan grangs mang po'i bar nas don gnyer chen pos nan du bskul ngor/ kho borgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal lam lce
sa khye 1 sgom chos kyis rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zhal bdugate dag par phab pa' yi ge pa nar+sā kertes gyis pa dge legs 'phel/sabo maṅga la/

yas /ཿ dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyi ༷ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaX ka dag tshig gi dbang mtha' grol 1nga yangs kyi chu bo bzhugs soḥcirngo 1 / na mogu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki yaḥ bskoshesarwa / rigs dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i dpal pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal rags bzang thugs kyi bu chen la yang gsang don gyi dbang mchog bstan sa ma yāḥ de yang sher dkar me long dang 'od lnga'i thig le rnam pa gsum skye med a yis gzi byin phab 'gags med brda yi dal du mos slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyang tho 'tshams bgegs ba da srung gur sgom maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni e ma gzhi snang 'khrul ba ka dag cingaḥ gzhi dbyings ye shes mngon gyur phyir cig char ngo sprod tshig gi dbangaX spros med rdo rje bdag la stsolaḥ lan gsum zhu de nas bla mas bka' ༅ pa e ma spros med rdo rje rigs kyi buḥ mtha' grol chig rdzogs tshig gi dbangaḥ mnyam pa chen por sbyin dgos na 'dzin rtog mtshan ma'i rgya grol bar rang byung ye shes mthong bar gyis rgyu 'bras las 'das chos nyid don yongs la sgrogs par mi bya'oḥ tshig phyir rtog ge mi byed cingaḥ 'dod sred mtshan ma'i rgya grol na don gyi

dbang chen sbyin bgyi'oḥ gnad mi ldan rnams phyir dengs shigaḥ ces dbye bsal bya de nas mna' chu sbyin pa ni e ma hoḥ bde gshegs snying po chos kyi skuḥ rang byung ye shes ye sangs rgyas rang la ye nas mnyam rdzogs pa ji bzhin mngon tu gyur bar mdzodaX gzhan la yongs su sgrogs mi bya lta sgom spyod pa'i dam tshig niḥ spros med don gyi dgongs pa las nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'o badz+ra kwa wā tsi25 ma ya na ra gnaḥ de nas slob ma rnamasardo rje 'chang chen por gsal la dbyings nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te dbab bstim nan du byasal bstan par bzhugasasu gsol de nas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bcas te e maḥ nam mkha'i rdo rjede bzhin nyid kun khyab mtha' dbus mi dmigs paX rang la rang dbang thob pa'i phyir ye shes 'jug pa stsal du gsolaḥ zhesalan gsum zhus te slob ma rnam rdo rje chos bdun gya sdod rdo rje slob dpon gyis blta ltangs nam mkhar gzags te phyag sdigs mdzub dang bcas nas ngo sprod pa niḥ e ma hoḥ bsam du med de nam mkha' che 'di la mtha' dbus spros dang bral mtshan ma'i chos rnams kun las dben chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba'oḥ a a bsam brjod bral ba'i ye shes ni rtag chad mtha' grol chen

yas 1ཿ po'oḥ gtang bzung sgom dmigs ched 'dzin grolaX gang yang byar du med pa'oX a aḥ sor bzhag dgongs pa mtha' grol laX lta sgom spyod pa'i tha snyad sgrolaḥ yin min 'dzin stangs dag pa la rang bzhag gsal stong chen po'oḥ a aḥ mkha' gting bral b.lichos nyid don bsal bzhag med pa gser gling bzhinaḥ ye shesathugs kyi klong chen po ༷ 'di don rtogs mdzod rigs kyi buḥ a aḥ mtshan malichos la sgro 'dog chodaḥ mtshan med dbyings la mnga' dbang bsgyuraX so so rang rig rjen par skyongaX klong chen 'bras bu mngon gyur mdzod ༷ a pāṭaḥ ashāṭa0 ashāṭaḥ de ltar mnyam bzhag ngo sprod gdab blo bral rtogs pa rjen la phud ye shes gting gsal mthong bar 'gyuraḥched 'dzan bral ba'i myongab thob sa ma yu de nas bla mas thugs dam tshig gi rten shel rdo gtad la gimed ka nas dag pa'i klongaḥ mdangs ldan shel dkar brda thabs laḥ brten nas rang byung ye shes kyi dri bral dgongs pa mngon gyur shog a tset+ta badz+ra a snyi ṣiñtsa hrīX de nas ya dam gyi thugs rten me long gto la mtha' dbus midachags grwa zur bralaX rnam rtog mtshan ma'i dri kun dben lhun

mnyam bde ba chen po'i dbangaX rtogs pa rgyas phyir bu la sbyinaḥ a cit+ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ de nas mkha' 'gra'i thugs rten 'od lnga'i thig le gtad laḥ hū hrīḥ nyag gcig thig le bde chen klong mu bzhi'i mtshan ma rang sar grolaḥ klong chen sku gsum mngon gyur phyir mkha' 'gro'i brda dbang bu la sbyin: a cit+ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa baṃ dbang de dag gi mthus sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangaX ye shes gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa la dbang thobaX rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyams su myong lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi sa la spyod pa'i mthu thobaḥ ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon tu gyur ba'i dgos ched yod doḥ bkra shas tshogs ston rgya cher bya de nas shis pa bo da pa na na moḥ skye med ka nas dag pa'i klong 'gags med zang thal ye shes 'khyilaX blo bral rtogs pa 'phel rgyas phyir0 chos nyid don gyi bkra shis thegagaḥ de ltar tshig dbang thob pa yas lhan skyes rtogs pa mngon sum mthongaḥ sa ma māḥye ma rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje yas dgongs brda snyan rgyud cig rdzogs su dam chos grol ba'i thig le'i skor lce sgom chos kyi rdo rjer stsalaḥ re zhig dgongs pa'i mthal rgyas btabaḥ rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe rdo rje'i zhing bzang smin pa'i phyir phrin las
——1/ byed po spya'amarga thugs kyi gdul zhing ma lusapa 'od gsal dgongs pas 2la bar shogaḥsabo ma lo/

ra 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa lasaX rig pa'i rtsal dbang cig char lhun rdzogs kyi chu bo bzhugs soḥgs 1 gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni ya na mo thababodzoms sku gsum bsam mi khyabs pa'i klong don gyi bla ma la phyag 'tshalaḥrnal 'byor thugs kyi bu chen la rag pa stsal gyi dbang mchog bstanaḥ sam yu de mngam dkar dbyings thag dang rma bya lug rgyud rnam pa gsumaḥ snying po don gyi sngags rkya btab/ lhun grub brda yi mdzod du dmigs slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyang bgegs tshogs bskrad la bsrung 'khor sgomaḥ maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol bdab niḥ e maḥ gzhi snang lhun grub dkyil 'khor loḥ ye shes chen po thob bya'i phyir rig pa rtsal gyi dbang dngos grubaḥ dri bral rdo rje bdag la stsol lan gsum zhu de nas bla mas bka' tsho baḥ e ma dri bral rdo rje bdag la dgongasaḥ cig chod thod rgal rtsal gyi dbang spros bral klong yangs sbyin dgos na tha mal mtshan 'dzin rgya grol bar rang byung ye shes gting gsal ngos khyab brdal 'od gsal mngon gyur mdzod de don gzhan la smra mi bya re dogs 'phrang las rab brgal zhing stong zhen dben cing mnyam gnas naX

rig rtsal rtags kyi dbang sbyin noX gnad las g.yel rnams phyir dengs shigaḥ ces dbye bsal bya de nas dam tshig gsang ba'i mna' chu sbyin pa ni e ma hoḥ bde gshegs snying po bum sku'i mdzod rigs dang dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i klong rang la gnyis med mnyam rdzogs pa ji bzhin gzigs pas mngon gyur mdzodaḥ de don gzhan la 'chol mi bya lta sgom spyod pa'igand gsang rnams rtsol sgrub bral bar skyongs pa las nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'oḥ badz+ra kwa wā tsi sa ma yā na ra gnaḥ de nas slob ma rnams kun tu bzang por gsal gdab dbyings nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la dbab bstim nan du byas la bstan par bzhugs su gsol de nas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bcas la e ma lhun sdo/ba 'do/sa ma byas pa'i dbyings sku dang ye shes chenags pa'i mdzodaḥrang 〈snang rang dbang bsgyur nus phyir ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 36paḥ zhes lan gsum zhus la slob ma rnam rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi bzhugasastangs la gnas shing rdo rje slob dpon gyis blta stangs nam mkhar gzigs te phyag sdigs mdzub dang bcas te ngo sprod pa ni e ma hoḥ tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na dkar 'jam stong pa 'od kyi klongaX che phra'i ye shes gting gsal bzhugs 'di

mas 1 don rtogs mdzod rigs kyi buḥ a aḥ 'char sgo rgyang chung gdos po'i lamaḥ rgyang chen 'od gsal mthong ba'i sgoX thabs mchog myur bde'i brtul zhugs kyis sgron ma yul la 'phel bar mdzodaX asaḥ dbyings kyi phyi 'byung mkha' ltar dgaX thig le'i nang 'byung 'od du sdud lug rgyud 'bar ba'i mtshan 'dzin gzhigaḥ dbyings gsum 'khor lo mngon gyur mdzodaḥ a aX mngon sum zhing sgobakod pa'i dbusaX gong 'phel 'od gsal da la rtsa tshad pheb longs sku'i bkod pa ngomasaḥ a ti'i lha sku zhal mjal mdzodaḥ a aḥ thams cad zang thal nyid du grolaḥ chos zad blo 'das rgyal sa rtsa phra ba'i sgrib pa kun bcom te klong chen sku gsum mngon gyur mdzodaḥ a pāṭaḥ a pāṭaX a pāṭa de ltar mnyam bzhag ngo sprod gdab klong gsal shes rab brda sgo 'byed sa ma shāḥde nas bla ma' zugs dam tshig gi rten a dkar gtad la 33 skye ba med pa de bzhin nyid sgyu 'phrul gsang lam a gcig maḥ drin bral rtogs phyir bu la gtad ye grol dgongs pa mngon gyur regagaX a tsit+ta badz+ra a snyi 〉〉 hri de na yi dam gyi thugs dam tshag gi rten rma bya lug rgyud gto la

a dug 'joms dri bral rma bya'i mdangs 'od lnga lhun grub bkra ba 'diX nang don rtogs pa mngon gyur zhing ye shes rtogs phyir bu la sbyin a cit+ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ de nasamakha' 'gro'i thugs dam tshag gi rten dbyings dang zig le gtad laḥ hū hrīḥ dbyings ni rgya tshad bral ba laḥ ye shes thig le mnyam nyid rdzogasaX don dam chos sku'i gsang mdzod klong ༷ rtogs phyir brda dbang bu la sbyin a tsit+ta badz+ra a bhi shiñtsa paṃḥ dbang de dag gi mthus snang gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangasaḥ mtshan ma dang bral ba'i ye shes gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa la dbang thobaḥ de kho na nyid kyi 'od gsal nyams su myong sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i sa la dbang ba'i mthu thob mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku rtag khyab lhun gyi mdzad pa la spyod pa'i dgos ched yod doḥ bkra shis tshogs ston rgya cher bya de nas shas pa brjod pa ni na moḥ 'od gsal sgrib g.yog bral ba'i klong lhun grub gsang ba bsam mtha' yas 'bad med mngon sum mthong ba'i phyir rtsal rdzogs ye shes bkra shis 31gaḥ de ltar rtsal dbang thob pa yis rin chen snying po' mdzod mthong sa ma māḥ ye ma rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje yis dgongs brda snyan

ra nga 1 brgyud cig ོgas su grol thig man ngag mthar thug pa snyesgom chosakyirdo rjer stsalaḥre zhig dgongs par rgyas bawa nas rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe dbang bo'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor gdams mdzod rgya bkrol phran las pa ra ki sabagyis pa'oḥ'abrel tshad rag 'dzan zhing spyod cang 'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub par shogaḥsarba maṅga la/

ngan nyams rtog ci shar kyangaX de bzhin nyid du zhog cig buX ye shes yon tan rdo rje mthongaḥ a aḥ dman pa'i gnas dang 'khrul ba'i 'phrang: tshad ma rtog ge grub pa'i mtha' thams cad mnyam nyid ngang la zhogaX ye shes phrin las rdo rjes sgrol ༷ a a de bzhin nyid ni rnam dag kyangaX lhun grub bde chen rgyal po'i mdangasaḥ 'bad med sku gnyis mdzad phrin rnams rgyun gyis rtag dang rgyun mi 'chadaX rnam pa bsam dang brjod las 'dasaX de don ngo mtshar a la la a a aX de nas brtul zhugs kyis dbang la rdo rje slobs dpon he ru ga'ichas su zhugs te ḍa dril 'khrol nas 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hūṃ (ཿ snang ba 'di ni sprul sku'i zhing0 lha snang rgyu 'phrul dra ba laḥ mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i rtsal rgyas naḥ gsang ba chen po mngon sum mthongaḥ sprul sku'i zhing bkod logs na medaḥ rig rtsal ma 'gags a la laḥhrī hrī hrīḥ snang ba 'di nilongs sku'i zhingaX 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i klongaḥ rang rig rtogs pa'irtsal rgyas na zang thal klong yangs bkod pa mjalaḥ longs sku'i zhing bkod logs na medaḥ rig gdangs ye mnyam a la laḥ a a.aḥ snang ba 'dinichos sku'i zhing nges

yas 1ཿ bdud rtsi bzhus nas rtsa khams khyabaḥ rtsa gsum dam can dgyes pa bskangasaḥ dga' bzhi stong pa 'od gsal dngaḥ dbang dang ye shes brin las sgo sa lamanyams rtogs rim pa rnams yar ngos zla ltar 'phel rgyas byedaḥ shes rab gtum mo'i las su 'byungaḥ sa ma āḥ rgya rgya rgya rjes byung bdestong gi rnal 'byoralho 'o mug jayir banas gtsang btsan mched kyi gsang bkrol ba 'ja'alusado(sdedagongs pa'i mthil ma dang ḍak+ki'i bdor bstan pa ཿ dam chos grol ba'i thig le nyid lcesgom tsha kyirdo rje yis bka' bsathub bstan dbang po la tshe bsrengs daradang nor mchog snag sna lnga'i gzungs thag bsgrub pa'i skyes ngo mtshan rten 'brel phun tshogs phyir rin chen shog skyar bkod pas phul bka' 'di shan tu gnyan pa'i phyir spel ma snga la bsdams ma drag rin chen srog las btsa'ashes mdzod sarba maṅga le/ zhal bkro/

yas 1 dam chos grol b.lir+shag lelhaḥ zab rtag yang snyeng 'dus pa lasaḥ rig 'dzin gsang lam gyibasrung bya dam tsheg gi zab gnad zhes bya babazhugs soḥ 76/ na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra yeḥ 31—༄6 chos nyid zhizheng rnam rol khroX bde gshegs spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung rigs dang dkyil 'khor 'dusapa'i dpalaX snying dbus dad brgya'i ze'u 'brur rol sa ma yā a nu yo galirnal 'byor baḥ khams gsum rol rtsed bsgyur ba po'i rdo rje padro'i bcud la rolaX chu mi 'thungaba'i dam tshig la rnam grangs nyi shu gsum gyi bstanaḥ sa ma yāX mdze bo gzhan gyi skyon du bltaḥ rang blo gzhan la mi 'jug steḥ dam las nyams la 'jems pa niX mje bo ltabu'i brtul zhugs soXsnyiḥdaman dang phal ba zil gyis gnonaX dri bral bde ba'i gangs rtse ru nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba niX gdong lnga'i dbang po'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyi chags pa 'dam dzad lcar gnas kyangaḥ smag col dri ma kun las dbenaḥ bsil lngan gtsang mar gnas pa niḥ glang po che brjid brtsal zhugs soḥsnyu ༷jo rje chu 'thung 'dra mnyam

kyang dwangs snyigs bye brag 'byed pa dngaX gangs dkar rtsi yis khyab pa niX ngang dkar mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs soX 3niḥ zla ba nyi mab bzhu na 'ang ldog pa mda' las drangasabazhin du rang gnas mkha' ru 'khrul ba niḥ drang sgong gtsang ma'i brtul zhugs soXñtsāḥ dmangs rnams rje bo'i mnga' 'og 'dud chags sems rtog pas gdan tshul brdziḥkun la mi 'jigs gdengs thob pa rgyal po 'khor bsgyur brtul zhugs soḥ3)༷ rtsa sgo pad+ma'i lcags kyus 'byedaX bde ba'i gsang rgya bsam yas paḥ las kyi lde'u mig nyid la dbang che phra'i btsun mo'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyiḥ mig sogs dbang po bkra na'ang rgya mtshos mi 'chang skyon dang bralaḥ thabs kyis gos dang rgyan du byedaḥ ru sbal 'jug pa'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyi nang don spang dang rtogs pa'i gnadaX gnyis gnyis mdud grol yon tan sgo gzhan la tsakyu rgya bsdam pa skugs pa dang mtshungs brtul zhugs so snyi lus rdul rdo rje'i rtsed mo byaḥ ngag gis hi nyaḥ dbu mar sbyoraḥ sems lnga zag med gcer bur byungaḥ mtshang grol spyon pa'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyiḥrdo rjes chu bo gyen du bzlog

yas 1 steng gi ga'u zin pa dngaX gzhan la 'jigs med gdeng thob pa gnas rgyal wa mo'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyiḥ bde ba'i 'gros la rtag par rgyugs rkun bsrung tha tshig gzu bor gnasaḥ bcud sgo 'dzag med bcing ba niḥ khyi bzang rngam pa'i brtul zhus soX snyiḥ gtsang sme'i rtog pa thad gar chodaḥ bdud rtsi lnga la zas su spyod lha klu rigs ngan pad+mor zaḥ mnyam pa phag gi brtul shugs soḥsnyiX 'khyel ba rlung gis bskyod na'ang 'khor lo lnga la 'dzag med bcingaX rlabs kun rang gnas nyid du 'khyil rgya mtsho lta bu'i brtul zhugs so 3niḥ mtha' dbus bral ba bde ba'i klongaḥ bcu drug phyi min nang ma yinaX gnyis su med pa a nu'i gas ngaḥ nam mkha' mtha' grol brtul zhugs soḥsnyiḥ phyi nang nyi zla'i 'gros mgyogs can rkang pa rlung gi rta la byasaḥ 'phrod kyis bum par za ba niḥ sgra gcan 'bar ba'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyiḥ dkar ni bde ba'i rnams par 'khyilaX dmar la chags pa'i shugs dang ldanaX gnyis med rlang gi 'phrod kyis bsreḥ rdzas spyor mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs soḥsnyiḥ ldang ba bla bre'i 'khor lo brten gnas

sa bum pa'i brjid la brten rol pa pad+ma'i mtsho la spyodaḥ mkha' lding za ba'i brtul zhugs so snyi dug gis dug phyogs 'joms pa dang dri ma'i rdul dang g.ya' sogs bsal nang nas 'bar ba'i shel gong gtams dug sgrol rma bya'i brtul zhugs so snyi rgong sbubs gnas bshin rtsal rgyas ltar sa lam rim pa rtogs rtsal 'phelaḥ 'byung rdul ye shes mkha' dang 'dreḥ nyi ma sprin grol brtul zhugs so snyiḥ gom pa'i stabs kyis yul lnga brgal 'gros chen tshul gyis rang gnas 'dzinaX 'gyeng dang gar bskor bskyil bcas 'dzomaḥ gyi lang rgal 'phar brtul zhugs soḥsnyi 'gyogs pa rlung gi bang rtsal can rgya mtsho chu la son pa dang stobs kyi zla skar gral du sleb pho nya lta bu'i brtul zhugs soXsnyi rim gyi zag pa kun zad nas bde stong spros bral zung du 'jugaḥ mkhyen brtse nus dpal rgya mtshor dbang ri bo lta bu'i brtul zhugs soX ñtsā dam 3ga 'di rnams dang bral b.raḥ sngags pa pad+mor spyod pa na dwangs bcud nyung 'bru tsam stor na rdo rje'i dmyal bar mnang nges so snyi rab ni rdo rje'i mda' dben pa'i lha mo klu mo

yas 1 rigs ngan mo bcu gsum bco lnga bcu drug tshadaX der brten dngos grub 'byung bar bshad snyiḥsug samagar mo dam sri moḥ'achang na dngos grub yal bdangaḥsha za rus 'cha' rkang ldag masaḥtshe srog bsod nams dpal la 'jibaḥs ma yāḥdabye bsal mkhasashing gzu bor gnasaḥsngags spyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rnams nyergyu'i lam nas mthong lam rnyedaX mi slob sa la e ma hoḥs ma māḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgyaXbarda thim snyiḥrig 'aram̐n 'a' lu rdo rje yis dgongs brda chig ོgas zab gter mthil ste ༄ masakyi rdorjes rnyed shin tu gsang bar 'chang 'dod kyang gtsang btsan mchad kya thabs su bskul shes rab ḍak+ki'i glu yis drangs smon lam 'phro bzangagab dbang posanor mchog snag dang bzung thag skyes bkra shis dar dang maṇ+ḍalamachog bsgrub pa'i skyes bcas bskul ba'i ngor rin chen shog skyar bkod pa dges chosargyud 'dzin mdzad thams cad kun rig 'dzin gral du 'khod gyur cagaḥsarba maṅga le/

yas 1 dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab taig yang snyeng 'dus pa lasaḥ nges sbyor bcud len gyi rnal 'byor bde ba'i dngos grub zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ yas 1 na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye shin tu mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs kyis gdan gsum sprin phung 'khrigs la btudaḥ zhen med bya btang rnal 'byor laḥ dgos pa'i nye lam bcud len bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ zab pa rdo yi bcud len laḥ cung zhi zhib btags phye ma dang mkhar rdo rkang rdo'i phye ma rnamasaḥ chang rnyang khu bas ngar bstims nasaḥ 'bri brgya'i mar gyi ril bu ni0 sran ma gsum gyi tshad du byaḥrta dang phag gi zhal gyis sgrub 'ja' 'od dri bzang 'thul ba'i tsheX rin chen shel gyi bum par blugasaḥ dben pa'i gnas su dam rgya bcadaḥ bde stong rlung 'gro'i rnal 'byor sgomaḥ nyin bzhin ril bu bdun cha yisaḥ bza' dang btung ba'i tshab mar bya gom pa'i rgyu las rebri bzhinaX gcig gi lto ba'i 'tsho rten byedaḥdel rlang gzhal gsos gdab 'phel tshad yon tan 'byor ba'i dusaḥ 'byung ba'i zag pa zad pa las tshe dpal bkrag mdangs

'phel zhing rgyasaX grub pa'i yon tan bsam yas 'byung rtags dang mtshan ma khyad 'phags ston gzhan snang dbang du bsgyur bar nges the tshom med do sa ma māḥ zab pa sa yi bcud len laḥ sismyo ra dang cu gang dngaḥ snyi haṃ gnas sa mang du bsags 'o ma chu sna'i ril bu ni ri bong ril ma tsam du byaḥ bde dang stong pa'i dal du mos kha sbyor lung gi rnal 'byor bsgomaḥ ril bu gsum la brten bcas nasaḥ 'tsho ba lus kyi rten du byedaḥ tshe dang bkrag mdangs stobs 'phel 'gyuraḥ the tshom med do sa ma yā de nas sman gyi sbyor ba niḥ a ru skyu ru si si ling bzang drug mngar gsum bsres pa dngaX 'bri brgya'i mar la sbyar byas teḥ ril bu tshigs kyi tshad tsam bya bde stong rlung gi rnal 'byor sgomaḥ byin rlabs dbab bstim nan du bya de nas 'tsho ba'i rten du 'changaḥ ril bu gsum la tshad du byaḥ sha rgyas bkrag 'phel tshe stobs dpal ༷ bsod nams yon tan gter thob 'gyur the 31ma med 〈sna sa ma yā me ma rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje yas 'od gsal sgyu ma' gsang mdzod bdo ste gem nam mkha' rnal 'byor la dus phab sa mo yos kyi lor dgongs brda snyan brgyud chag ོgas bab lcags

sa shā 1 'byug ral brgya'i 'dab ma la sgrub mdzod yid 'azhin nor bu bkrol dkar po dug lce 'dzin ma'i khyon man ngag zab pa'i mdzod chen bstanaḥrlan gyi cang shes sgyu rtsal can de la rgyab chos dus gnadalags gtsang btsan gang dkar she ne dang bde stong gsang ba'i ḍak+ki yis brda dang thabs dang glu yis bskul rten 'brel rtags mtshan bzang po ra shes chos bdagathub bstan dbang po yas shin tu dge ba'i skyes dang bcasayang yang bskul ba don ldan phyiraḥstobatsun tshasakyirdo rje yis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zhal bsas nas shog skyar bkod pa'i yi ge pa ཿsaman snya tra ma ṇis so sarba maṅga le/

chas / dam chos grol ba'i thig lesnyiḥ zab tig yang snying 'dus pa las rta phag bde sbyor gyi gsang ba gsum gyi man ngag gi rgyab yig yid bzhin dpal ster bzhugs soḥ 76/ na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra yeḥ 2441jamatsho bde stong mnyam pa nyid du spyoraX sgrub sde'i dpa' bo mchog la btudaḥ skal ba bzang po'i skyes bu yiX bgo skal man ngag zab mdzod bstanaX sa ma yāX zab pa'i yang rtse ches zab pa gsang ba las kyang shin tu gsang0 ring ba'i lam la mi ltos pasaḥ nye lam sngags zhes yongs su grags gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa yisaX drangs bas 'od gsal ches phra baḥ mthong tshad tshe lus gcig pu yisaX rig 'dzin gral 'khod grub rtser 'khodaḥ 'di la brtes rgol dmod mi rungaḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo nyid dang sbyoraḥ bcu drug zung brtse spros bral bsgomaḥ bo la gak+ko gnyis mnyam pas chos dbying rig pa gcer bur mthongaḥ kun khyab 'od gsal dri med rgyasaḥ gzod ma'i ngang mdangs stogs pa 'charaḥ mtha' ru chad pas gnyis ka yang rlang bcas dbu mar zhugs gnas thimaḥ phyi nang rtags

tshad 'phel rgyas 'gyuraḥ dhu ti'i snang ba mtha' bral ba pad+ma lnga bkod 'phel rgyas grol lam 'di blo gros can la dbang mun pa sra ga ra la ring de phyir las smon 'dzom pas 'chongaḥ sa ma yā0 shin tu gsang ba thig le'i dpyidaḥ rlung gis bskul ba'i thabs chen gyi lam la drangs bas ye shes rgyasaX rtsa rlung thig le'i bzhugs tshul dngaḥ de don bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor lamaX nges par sbyor ba'i bcud len gnadaX bdud rtsi bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dngaḥ kha bskang gzhung bsrang rgya mdud dang phan yon rgyas 'debs dang bcas pa'iḥ rim pa brgyad kyi yongs rdzogs bstan reg pa dug gi lce 'dzin pasaX snang ba rgyal khams yongs la mngon dus gnad rten 'brel gnyis pa laḥ rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje yi mi 'gyur 'od gsal dgongs brda'i mdzodaḥ 'o yug rdza yi ra ba nasaḥ gtsang btsan mched 'khor sum brgya drug: 'o yug brtan ma she ne+e yis rten 'brel thabs kyis legs bskul nasaḥ lce bsgom nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyisaḥ lcags 'brug ral brgya'i 'dab mar sonaḥ lung gis bsngags pa'i dus tshigs suḥ yid bzhin dpal ster mdzod

chas 1 gsum dabhe ཿ cha lags chu bo drug ldan dbangaḥ sbas don rdol tshig gsang gnad bkrolaḥ dus tshigs 'gyur med gnyis pa'i skabs ༷ man ngag nang gi skor kha zhes0 'od gsal bde ba thig le'i lam rgyab skor gnad gyi me long bcasaḥ legs par dus gsal snang ba'oḥ sa ma yāḥ sngon smon rten 'brel bzang po yiX mthu las byung ba'i chos bdag niḥ rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang rnal 'byor lngaḥ thub bstan dbang dang pad+ma rgyalaḥ dge legs dpal bzang seng ge'i sgraḥ pad+ma mkha' grub bya ba'o phrin las mtha' rgyas skyes bulngaḥ mkhas btsun shī ma bkra shis dpalaḥ dge bzang g.yin phan rgya mtsho dngaḥ 'gro 'dul dzñā na dh+wa ja steX bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du 'byung rten 'brel dag pas phun sum tshogasaḥ 'gro don brin las bsam yas 'byungaḥ mi bslu mkha' 'gro'i gtan tshigs stsalaḥ ste bsgom chos kyi rdo rje yisaḥ rin chen shog skyar bkod pa dgesaḥ rnal 'byor thub bstanadabang po yiḥ thugs kyi bzhed don 'grub pa dang brin las mi nub 'phel rgyas phyiraḥ bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'jug par zhu 'od lus grub pa'i rten 'brel cheX sarba maṅga le/
